- **Deletions**: -9
- **Created**: 2026-10-13T10:39:39Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-13T20:18:01Z

## PR Description

Closes #1573
### Root Cause

- `TranscriptMarkdown._rebuild()` re-parsed an appended tail **without the open-block state latched at the commit boundary** (`lib/src/cli/ansi_markdown.dart`). A fence/table whose opener was already committed left its closing line context-less in the tail, so it fell through the in-fence early-out and was emitted again as plain top-level markdown. Each subsequent status `sendOutput` (background-job notices, `/work · Ntok` lines) repeated the commit and grew the duplicate tail — 3–4 copies of the final answer.
- Secondary (low-priority item in the ticket): `fa config check` with `cwd=~` resolved the project scope to `~/.fah/config.yaml` itself and ran the project pass over the same bytes twice, warning every user-only key (`provider`, `model`, `baseUrl`, …) as "dead config".

### Fix

- `lib/src/cli/ansi_markdown.dart`: latch `_pendingFence` / table style / pending-table state at every `_commitTo()` boundary; seed `_walk()` from it and carry per-step block state; grown-tail rollback now rebuilds from the boundary **with the latched seed**, so the closing line is consumed as a block close instead of re-emitted; `_viewRows` is `boundaryRows + tailRows` — never appended onto stale rows.
- `lib/src/config/config_service.dart`: when `projectConfigPath == globalConfigPath`, `check()` skips the project pass with the note `project config resolves to the global file — skipped: …`.

### Test Coverage

- `test/cli/transcript_answer_once_test.dart` (new): 4 cases driving a real `TranscriptMarkdown` through the gh-1573 commit sequence (fence closed in a grown tail, rollback, mid-tail service traffic); each asserts the answer body and every table row appear **exactly once** — all 4 verified RED on the pre-fix code, GREEN after.
- `test/config/config_service_test.dart`: `cwd == home` case — RED pre-fix (user-only keys warned as dead config), GREEN after.
- Targeted suites re-run green after the fix: `ansi_markdown_test`, `transcript_answer_once_test`, `tui_chrome_test`, `transcript_table_render_test`, `fa_tui_boot_output_coalesce_test`, `fa_tui_test`, `transcript_markdown_perf_test`, `resume_perf_503_test`, all of `test/config/` (493 tests total across these).
- Full `dart test` suite: see final result below (job `sh-123-hn65f29u1o1o5uiei`).

### Notes

- No public API changes; `_WalkResult` gained the seed fields (private class).
- `fa config path` still lists the coincident file under both labels by design — the check pass no longer double-validates it.

- Secondary (low-priority item in the ticket): `fa config check` with `cwd=~` resolved the project scope to `~/.fah/config.yaml` itself and ran the project pass over the same bytes twice, warning every user-only key (`provider`, `model`, `baseUrl`, …) as "dead config".

### Fix

- `lib/src/cli/ansi_markdown.dart`: latch `_pendingFence` / table style / pending-table state at every `_commitTo()` boundary; seed `_walk()` from it and carry per-step block state; grown-tail rollback now rebuilds from the boundary **with the latched seed**, so the closing line is consumed as a block close instead of re-emitted; `_viewRows` is `boundaryRows + tailRows` — never appended onto stale rows.
- `lib/src/config/config_service.dart`: when `projectConfigPath == globalConfigPath`, `check()` skips the project pass with the note `project config resolves to the global file — skipped: …`.

### Test Coverage

- `test/cli/transcript_answer_once_test.dart` (new): 4 cases driving a real `TranscriptMarkdown` through the gh-1573 commit sequence (fence closed in a grown tail, rollback, mid-tail service traffic); each asserts the answer body and every table row appear **exactly once** — all 4 verified RED on the pre-fix code, GREEN after.
- `test/config/config_service_test.dart`: `cwd == home` case — RED pre-fix (user-only keys warned as dead config), GREEN after.
- Targeted suites re-run green after the fix: `ansi_markdown_test`, `transcript_answer_once_test`, `tui_chrome_test`, `transcript_table_render_test`, `fa_tui_boot_output_coalesce_test`, `fa_tui_test`, `transcript_markdown_perf_test`, `resume_perf_503_test`, all of `test/config/` (493 tests total across these).
- Full `dart test` suite: see final result below (job `sh-123-hn65f29u1o1o5uiei`).

### Notes

- No public API changes; `_WalkResult` gained the seed fields (private class).
- `fa config path` still lists the coincident file under both labels by design — the check pass no longer double-validates it.

- Secondary (low-priority item in the ticket): `fa config check` with `cwd=~` resolved the project scope to `~/.fah/config.yaml` itself and ran the project pass over the same bytes twice, warning every user-only key (`provider`, `model`, `baseUrl`, …) as "dead config".

### Fix

- `lib/src/cli/ansi_markdown.dart`: latch `_pendingFence` / table style / pending-table state at every `_commitTo()` boundary; seed `_walk()` from it and carry per-step block state; grown-tail rollback now rebuilds from the boundary **with the latched seed**, so the closing line is consumed as a block close instead of re-emitted; `_viewRows` is `boundaryRows + tailRows` — never appended onto stale rows.
- `lib/src/config/config_service.dart`: when `projectConfigPath == globalConfigPath`, `check()` skips the project pass with the note `project config resolves to the global file — skipped: …`.

### Test Coverage

- `test/cli/transcript_answer_once_test.dart` (new): 4 cases driving a real `TranscriptMarkdown` through the gh-1573 commit sequence (fence closed in a grown tail, rollback, mid-tail service traffic); each asserts the answer body and every table row appear **exactly once** — all 4 verified RED on the pre-fix code, GREEN after.
- `test/config/config_service_test.dart`: `cwd == home` case — RED pre-fix (user-only keys warned as dead config), GREEN after.
- Targeted suites re-run green after the fix: `ansi_markdown_test`, `transcript_answer_once_test`, `tui_chrome_test`, `transcript_table_render_test`, `fa_tui_boot_output_coalesce_test`, `fa_tui_test`, `transcript_markdown_perf_test`, `resume_perf_503_test`, all of `test/config/` (493 tests total across these).
- Full `dart test` suite: see final result below (job `sh-123-hn65f29u1o1o5uiei`).

### Notes

- No public API changes; `_WalkResult` gained the seed fields (private class).
- `fa config path` still lists the coincident file under both labels by design — the check pass no longer double-validates it.

- `lib/src/cli/ansi_markdown.dart`: latch `_pendingFence` / table style / pending-table state at every `_commitTo()` boundary; seed `_walk()` from it and carry per-step block state; grown-tail rollback now rebuilds from the boundary **with the latched seed**, so the closing line is consumed as a block close instead of re-emitted; `_viewRows` is `boundaryRows + tailRows` — never appended onto stale rows.
- `lib/src/config/config_service.dart`: when `projectConfigPath == globalConfigPath`, `check()` skips the project pass with the note `project config resolves to the global file — skipped: …`.

### Test Coverage

- `test/cli/transcript_answer_once_test.dart` (new): 4 cases driving a real `TranscriptMarkdown` through the gh-1573 commit sequence (fence closed in a grown tail, rollback, mid-tail service traffic); each asserts the answer body and every table row appear **exactly once** — all 4 verified RED on the pre-fix code, GREEN after.
- `test/config/config_service_test.dart`: `cwd == home` case — RED pre-fix (user-only keys warned as dead config), GREEN after.
- Targeted suites re-run green after the fix: `ansi_markdown_test`, `transcript_answer_once_test`, `tui_chrome_test`, `transcript_table_render_test`, `fa_tui_boot_output_coalesce_test`, `fa_tui_test`, `transcript_markdown_perf_test`, `resume_perf_503_test`, all of `test/config/` (493 tests total across these).
- Full `dart test` suite: see final result below (job `sh-123-hn65f29u1o1o5uiei`).

### Notes

- No public API changes; `_WalkResult` gained the seed fields (private class).
- `fa config path` still lists the coincident file under both labels by design — the check pass no longer double-validates it.

## PR Description

Closes #1573
### Root Cause

- `TranscriptMarkdown._rebuild()` re-parsed an appended tail **without the open-block state latched at the commit boundary** (`lib/src/cli/ansi_markdown.dart`). A fence/table whose opener was already committed left its closing line context-less in the tail, so it fell through the in-fence early-out and was emitted again as plain top-level markdown. Each subsequent status `sendOutput` (background-job notices, `/work · Ntok` lines) repeated the commit and grew the duplicate tail — 3–4 copies of the final answer.
- Secondary (low-priority item in the ticket): `fa config check` with `cwd=~` resolved the project scope to `~/.fah/config.yaml` itself and ran the project pass over the same bytes twice, warning every user-only key (`provider`, `model`, `baseUrl`, …) as "dead config".

### Fix

- No public API changes; `_WalkResult` gained the seed fields (private class).

# pr-1586: gh-1573 [BUG] TUI: final assistant answer rendered 3-4 times after a background bash job / btw notices

## Description

Closes #1573
### Root Cause

- `TranscriptMarkdown._rebuild()` re-parsed an appended tail **without the open-block state latched at the commit boundary** (`lib/src/cli/ansi_markdown.dart`). A fence/table whose opener was already committed left its closing line context-less in the tail, so it fell through the in-fence early-out and was emitted again as plain top-level markdown. Each subsequent status `sendOutput` (background-job notices, `/work · Ntok` lines) repeated the commit and grew the duplicate tail — 3–4 copies of the final answer.
- Secondary (low-priority item in the ticket): `fa config check` with `cwd=~` resolved the project scope to `~/.fah/config.yaml` itself and ran the project pass over the same bytes twice, warning every user-only key (`provider`, `model`, `baseUrl`, …) as "dead config".

### Fix

- `lib/src/cli/ansi_markdown.dart`: latch `_pendingFence` / table style / pending-table state at every `_commitTo()` boundary; seed `_walk()` from it and carry per-step block state; grown-tail rollback now rebuilds from the boundary **with the latched seed**, so the closing line is consumed as a block close instead of re-emitted; `_viewRows` is `boundaryRows + tailRows` — never appended onto stale rows.

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1586
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1586
- **Title**: gh-1573 [BUG] TUI: final assistant answer rendered 3-4 times after a background bash job / btw notices
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1573` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 4
- **Additions**: +373
- **Deletions**: -9
- **Created**: 2026-10-13T10:39:39Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-13T20:18:01Z

## PR Description

Closes #1573
### Root Cause

- `TranscriptMarkdown._rebuild()` re-parsed an appended tail **without the open-block state latched at the commit boundary** (`lib/src/cli/ansi_markdown.dart`). A fence/table whose opener was already committed left its closing line context-less in the tail, so it fell through the in-fence early-out and was emitted again as plain top-level markdown. Each subsequent status `sendOutput` (background-job notices, `/work · Ntok` lines) repeated the commit and grew the duplicate tail — 3–4 copies of the final answer.
- Secondary (low-priority item in the ticket): `fa config check` with `cwd=~` resolved the project scope to `~/.fah/config.yaml` itself and ran the project pass over the same bytes twice, warning every user-only key (`provider`, `model`, `baseUrl`, …) as "dead config".

### Fix

- `lib/src/cli/ansi_markdown.dart`: latch `_pendingFence` / table style / pending-table state at every `_commitTo()` boundary; seed `_walk()` from it and carry per-step block state; grown-tail rollback now rebuilds from the boundary **with the latched seed**, so the closing line is consumed as a block close instead of re-emitted; `_viewRows` is `boundaryRows + tailRows` — never appended onto stale rows.

# pr-1586: gh-1573 [BUG] TUI: final assistant answer rendered 3-4 times after a background bash job / btw notices

## Description

Closes #1573
### Root Cause

- `TranscriptMarkdown._rebuild()` re-parsed an appended tail **without the open-block state latched at the commit boundary** (`lib/src/cli/ansi_markdown.dart`). A fence/table whose opener was already committed left its closing line context-less in the tail, so it fell through the in-fence early-out and was emitted again as plain top-level markdown. Each subsequent status `sendOutput` (background-job notices, `/work · Ntok` lines) repeated the commit and grew the duplicate tail — 3–4 copies of the final answer.
- Secondary (low-priority item in the ticket): `fa config check` with `cwd=~` resolved the project scope to `~/.fah/config.yaml` itself and ran the project pass over the same bytes twice, warning every user-only key (`provider`, `model`, `baseUrl`, …) as "dead config".

### Fix

- `lib/src/cli/ansi_markdown.dart`: latch `_pendingFence` / table style / pending-table state at every `_commitTo()` boundary; seed `_walk()` from it and carry per-step block state; grown-tail rollback now rebuilds from the boundary **with the latched seed**, so the closing line is consumed as a block close instead of re-emitted; `_viewRows` is `boundaryRows + tailRows` — never appended onto stale rows.
- `lib/src/config/config_service.dart`: when `projectConfigPath == globalConfigPath`, `check()` skips the project pass with the note `project config resolves to the global file — skipped: …`.

### Test Coverage

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1586
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1586
- **Title**: gh-1573 [BUG] TUI: final assistant answer rendered 3-4 times after a background bash job / btw notices
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1573` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 4
- **Additions**: +373
- **Deletions**: -9
- **Created**: 2026-10-13T10:39:39Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-13T20:18:01Z

## PR Description

Closes #1573
### Root Cause

- `TranscriptMarkdown._rebuild()` re-parsed an appended tail **without the open-block state latched at the commit boundary** (`lib/src/cli/ansi_markdown.dart`). A fence/table whose opener was already committed left its closing line context-less in the tail, so it fell through the in-fence early-out and was emitted again as plain top-level markdown. Each subsequent status `sendOutput` (background-job notices, `/work · Ntok` lines) repeated the commit and grew the duplicate tail — 3–4 copies of the final answer.
- Secondary (low-priority item in the ticket): `fa config check` with `cwd=~` resolved the project scope to `~/.fah/config.yaml` itself and ran the project pass over the same bytes twice, warning every user-only key (`provider`, `model`, `baseUrl`, …) as "dead config".

### Fix

- `lib/src/cli/ansi_markdown.dart`: latch `_pendingFence` / table style / pending-table state at every `_commitTo()` boundary; seed `_walk()` from it and carry per-step block state; grown-tail rollback now rebuilds from the boundary **with the latched seed**, so the closing line is consumed as a block close instead of re-emitted; `_viewRows` is `boundaryRows + tailRows` — never appended onto stale rows.
- `lib/src/config/config_service.dart`: when `projectConfigPath == globalConfigPath`, `check()` skips the project pass with the note `project config resolves to the global file — skipped: …`.

### Test Coverage

- `test/cli/transcript_answer_once_test.dart` (new): 4 cases driving a real `TranscriptMarkdown` through the gh-1573 commit sequence (fence closed in a grown tail, rollback, mid-tail service traffic); each asserts the answer body and every table row appear **exactly once** — all 4 verified RED on the pre-fix code, GREEN after.
- `test/config/config_service_test.dart`: `cwd == home` case — RED pre-fix (user-only keys warned as dead config), GREEN after.
- Targeted suites re-run green after the fix: `ansi_markdown_test`, `transcript_answer_once_test`, `tui_chrome_test`, `transcript_table_render_test`, `fa_tui_boot_output_coalesce_test`, `fa_tui_test`, `transcript_markdown_perf_test`, `resume_perf_503_test`, all of `test/config/` (493 tests total across these).
- Full `dart test` suite: see final result below (job `sh-123-hn65f29u1o1o5uiei`).

### Notes

- No public API changes; `_WalkResult` gained the seed fields (private class).
- `fa config path` still lists the coincident file under both labels by design — the check pass no longer double-validates it.

# pr-1586: gh-1573 [BUG] TUI: final assistant answer rendered 3-4 times after a background bash job / btw notices

## Description

Closes #1573
### Root Cause

- `TranscriptMarkdown._rebuild()` re-parsed an appended tail **without the open-block state latched at the commit boundary** (`lib/src/cli/ansi_markdown.dart`). A fence/table whose opener was already committed left its closing line context-less in the tail, so it fell through the in-fence early-out and was emitted again as plain top-level markdown. Each subsequent status `sendOutput` (background-job notices, `/work · Ntok` lines) repeated the commit and grew the duplicate tail — 3–4 copies of the final answer.
- Secondary (low-priority item in the ticket): `fa config check` with `cwd=~` resolved the project scope to `~/.fah/config.yaml` itself and ran the project pass over the same bytes twice, warning every user-only key (`provider`, `model`, `baseUrl`, …) as "dead config".

### Fix

- `lib/src/cli/ansi_markdown.dart`: latch `_pendingFence` / table style / pending-table state at every `_commitTo()` boundary; seed `_walk()` from it and carry per-step block state; grown-tail rollback now rebuilds from the boundary **with the latched seed**, so the closing line is consumed as a block close instead of re-emitted; `_viewRows` is `boundaryRows + tailRows` — never appended onto stale rows.
- `lib/src/config/config_service.dart`: when `projectConfigPath == globalConfigPath`, `check()` skips the project pass with the note `project config resolves to the global file — skipped: …`.

### Test Coverage

- `test/cli/transcript_answer_once_test.dart` (new): 4 cases driving a real `TranscriptMarkdown` through the gh-1573 commit sequence (fence closed in a grown tail, rollback, mid-tail service traffic); each asserts the answer body and every table row appear **exactly once** — all 4 verified RED on the pre-fix code, GREEN after.
- `test/config/config_service_test.dart`: `cwd == home` case — RED pre-fix (user-only keys warned as dead config), GREEN after.
- Targeted suites re-run green after the fix: `ansi_markdown_test`, `transcript_answer_once_test`, `tui_chrome_test`, `transcript_table_render_test`, `fa_tui_boot_output_coalesce_test`, `fa_tui_test`, `transcript_markdown_perf_test`, `resume_perf_503_test`, all of `test/config/` (493 tests total across these).
- Full `dart test` suite: see final result below (job `sh-123-hn65f29u1o1o5uiei`).

### Notes

- No public API changes; `_WalkResult` gained the seed fields (private class).
- `fa config path` still lists the coincident file under both labels by design — the check pass no longer double-validates it.

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1586
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1586
- **Title**: gh-1573 [BUG] TUI: final assistant answer rendered 3-4 times after a background bash job / btw notices
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1573` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 4
- **Additions**: +373
- **Deletions**: -9
- **Created**: 2026-10-13T10:39:39Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-13T20:18:01Z

## PR Description

Closes #1573
### Root Cause

- `TranscriptMarkdown._rebuild()` re-parsed an appended tail **without the open-block state latched at the commit boundary** (`lib/src/cli/ansi_markdown.dart`). A fence/table whose opener was already committed left its closing line context-less in the tail, so it fell through the in-fence early-out and was emitted again as plain top-level markdown. Each subsequent status `sendOutput` (background-job notices, `/work · Ntok` lines) repeated the commit and grew the duplicate tail — 3–4 copies of the final answer.
- Secondary (low-priority item in the ticket): `fa config check` with `cwd=~` resolved the project scope to `~/.fah/config.yaml` itself and ran the project pass over the same bytes twice, warning every user-only key (`provider`, `model`, `baseUrl`, …) as "dead config".

### Fix

- `lib/src/cli/ansi_markdown.dart`: latch `_pendingFence` / table style / pending-table state at every `_commitTo()` boundary; seed `_walk()` from it and carry per-step block state; grown-tail rollback now rebuilds from the boundary **with the latched seed**, so the closing line is consumed as a block close instead of re-emitted; `_viewRows` is `boundaryRows + tailRows` — never appended onto stale rows.
- `lib/src/config/config_service.dart`: when `projectConfigPath == globalConfigPath`, `check()` skips the project pass with the note `project config resolves to the global file — skipped: …`.

### Test Coverage

- `test/cli/transcript_answer_once_test.dart` (new): 4 cases driving a real `TranscriptMarkdown` through the gh-1573 commit sequence (fence closed in a grown tail, rollback, mid-tail service traffic); each asserts the answer body and every table row appear **exactly once** — all 4 verified RED on the pre-fix code, GREEN after.
- `test/config/config_service_test.dart`: `cwd == home` case — RED pre-fix (user-only keys warned as dead config), GREEN after.
- Targeted suites re-run green after the fix: `ansi_markdown_test`, `transcript_answer_once_test`, `tui_chrome_test`, `transcript_table_render_test`, `fa_tui_boot_output_coalesce_test`, `fa_tui_test`, `transcript_markdown_perf_test`, `resume_perf_503_test`, all of `test/config/` (493 tests total across these).
- Full `dart test` suite: see final result below (job `sh-123-hn65f29u1o1o5uiei`).

### Notes

- No public API changes; `_WalkResult` gained the seed fields (private class).
- `fa config path` still lists the coincident file under both labels by design — the check pass no longer double-validates it.

# pr-1586: gh-1573 [BUG] TUI: final assistant answer rendered 3-4 times after a background bash job / btw notices

## Description

Closes #1573
### Root Cause

- `TranscriptMarkdown._rebuild()` re-parsed an appended tail **without the open-block state latched at the commit boundary** (`lib/src/cli/ansi_markdown.dart`). A fence/table whose opener was already committed left its closing line context-less in the tail, so it fell through the in-fence early-out and was emitted again as plain top-level markdown. Each subsequent status `sendOutput` (background-job notices, `/work · Ntok` lines) repeated the commit and grew the duplicate tail — 3–4 copies of the final answer.
- Secondary (low-priority item in the ticket): `fa config check` with `cwd=~` resolved the project scope to `~/.fah/config.yaml` itself and ran the project pass over the same bytes twice, warning every user-only key (`provider`, `model`, `baseUrl`, …) as "dead config".

### Fix

- `lib/src/cli/ansi_markdown.dart`: latch `_pendingFence` / table style / pending-table state at every `_commitTo()` boundary; seed `_walk()` from it and carry per-step block state; grown-tail rollback now rebuilds from the boundary **with the latched seed**, so the closing line is consumed as a block close instead of re-emitted; `_viewRows` is `boundaryRows + tailRows` — never appended onto stale rows.
- `lib/src/config/config_service.dart`: when `projectConfigPath == globalConfigPath`, `check()` skips the project pass with the note `project config resolves to the global file — skipped: …`.

### Test Coverage

- `test/cli/transcript_answer_once_test.dart` (new): 4 cases driving a real `TranscriptMarkdown` through the gh-1573 commit sequence (fence closed in a grown tail, rollback, mid-tail service traffic); each asserts the answer body and every table row appear **exactly once** — all 4 verified RED on the pre-fix code, GREEN after.
- `test/config/config_service_test.dart`: `cwd == home` case — RED pre-fix (user-only keys warned as dead config), GREEN after.
- Targeted suites re-run green after the fix: `ansi_markdown_test`, `transcript_answer_once_test`, `tui_chrome_test`, `transcript_table_render_test`, `fa_tui_boot_output_coalesce_test`, `fa_tui_test`, `transcript_markdown_perf_test`, `resume_perf_503_test`, all of `test/config/` (493 tests total across these).
- Full `dart test` suite: see final result below (job `sh-123-hn65f29u1o1o5uiei`).

### Notes

- No public API changes; `_WalkResult` gained the seed fields (private class).
- `fa config path` still lists the coincident file under both labels by design — the check pass no longer double-validates it.

- **Updated**: 2026-10-13T20:18:01Z

## PR Description

Closes #1573
### Root Cause

- `TranscriptMarkdown._rebuild()` re-parsed an appended tail **without the open-block state latched at the commit boundary** (`lib/src/cli/ansi_markdown.dart`). A fence/table whose opener was already committed left its closing line context-less in the tail, so it fell through the in-fence early-out and was emitted again as plain top-level markdown. Each subsequent status `sendOutput` (background-job notices, `/work · Ntok` lines) repeated the commit and grew the duplicate tail — 3–4 copies of the final answer.
- Secondary (low-priority item in the ticket): `fa config check` with `cwd=~` resolved the project scope to `~/.fah/config.yaml` itself and ran the project pass over the same bytes twice, warning every user-only key (`provider`, `model`, `baseUrl`, …) as "dead config".

### Fix

- `lib/src/cli/ansi_markdown.dart`: latch `_pendingFence` / table style / pending-table state at every `_commitTo()` boundary; seed `_walk()` from it and carry per-step block state; grown-tail rollback now rebuilds from the boundary **with the latched seed**, so the closing line is consumed as a block close instead of re-emitted; `_viewRows` is `boundaryRows + tailRows` — never appended onto stale rows.
- `lib/src/config/config_service.dart`: when `projectConfigPath == globalConfigPath`, `check()` skips the project pass with the note `project config resolves to the global file — skipped: …`.

### Test Coverage

- `test/cli/transcript_answer_once_test.dart` (new): 4 cases driving a real `TranscriptMarkdown` through the gh-1573 commit sequence (fence closed in a grown tail, rollback, mid-tail service traffic); each asserts the answer body and every table row appear **exactly once** — all 4 verified RED on the pre-fix code, GREEN after.
- `test/config/config_service_test.dart`: `cwd == home` case — RED pre-fix (user-only keys warned as dead config), GREEN after.
- Targeted suites re-run green after the fix: `ansi_markdown_test`, `transcript_answer_once_test`, `tui_chrome_test`, `transcript_table_render_test`, `fa_tui_boot_output_coalesce_test`, `fa_tui_test`, `transcript_markdown_perf_test`, `resume_perf_503_test`, all of `test/config/` (493 tests total across these).
- Full `dart test` suite: see final result below (job `sh-123-hn65f29u1o1o5uiei`).

### Notes

- No public API changes; `_WalkResult` gained the seed fields (private class).
- `fa config path` still lists the coincident file under both labels by design — the check pass no longer double-validates it.

# pr-1586: gh-1573 [BUG] TUI: final assistant answer rendered 3-4 times after a background bash job / btw notices

## Description

Closes #1573
### Root Cause

- `TranscriptMarkdown._rebuild()` re-parsed an appended tail **without the open-block state latched at the commit boundary** (`lib/src/cli/ansi_markdown.dart`). A fence/table whose opener was already committed left its closing line context-less in the tail, so it fell through the in-fence early-out and was emitted again as plain top-level markdown. Each subsequent status `sendOutput` (background-job notices, `/work · Ntok` lines) repeated the commit and grew the duplicate tail — 3–4 copies of the final answer.
- Secondary (low-priority item in the ticket): `fa config check` with `cwd=~` resolved the project scope to `~/.fah/config.yaml` itself and ran the project pass over the same bytes twice, warning every user-only key (`provider`, `model`, `baseUrl`, …) as "dead config".

### Fix

- `lib/src/cli/ansi_markdown.dart`: latch `_pendingFence` / table style / pending-table state at every `_commitTo()` boundary; seed `_walk()` from it and carry per-step block state; grown-tail rollback now rebuilds from the boundary **with the latched seed**, so the closing line is consumed as a block close instead of re-emitted; `_viewRows` is `boundaryRows + tailRows` — never appended onto stale rows.
- `lib/src/config/config_service.dart`: when `projectConfigPath == globalConfigPath`, `check()` skips the project pass with the note `project config resolves to the global file — skipped: …`.

### Test Coverage

- `test/cli/transcript_answer_once_test.dart` (new): 4 cases driving a real `TranscriptMarkdown` through the gh-1573 commit sequence (fence closed in a grown tail, rollback, mid-tail service traffic); each asserts the answer body and every table row appear **exactly once** — all 4 verified RED on the pre-fix code, GREEN after.
- `test/config/config_service_test.dart`: `cwd == home` case — RED pre-fix (user-only keys warned as dead config), GREEN after.
- Targeted suites re-run green after the fix: `ansi_markdown_test`, `transcript_answer_once_test`, `tui_chrome_test`, `transcript_table_render_test`, `fa_tui_boot_output_coalesce_test`, `fa_tui_test`, `transcript_markdown_perf_test`, `resume_perf_503_test`, all of `test/config/` (493 tests total across these).
- Full `dart test` suite: see final result below (job `sh-123-hn65f29u1o1o5uiei`).

### Notes

- No public API changes; `_WalkResult` gained the seed fields (private class).
- `fa config path` still lists the coincident file under both labels by design — the check pass no longer double-validates it.

Each subsequent status `sendOutput` (background-job notices, `/work · Ntok` lines) repeated the commit and grew the duplicate tail — 3–4 copies of the final answer.
- Secondary (low-priority item in the ticket): `fa config check` with `cwd=~` resolved the project scope to `~/.fah/config.yaml` itself and ran the project pass over the same bytes twice, warning every user-only key (`provider`, `model`, `baseUrl`, …) as "dead config".

### Fix

- `lib/src/cli/ansi_markdown.dart`: latch `_pendingFence` / table style / pending-table state at every `_commitTo()` boundary; seed `_walk()` from it and carry per-step block state; grown-tail rollback now rebuilds from the boundary **with the latched seed**, so the closing line is consumed as a block close instead of re-emitted; `_viewRows` is `boundaryRows + tailRows` — never appended onto stale rows.
- `lib/src/config/config_service.dart`: when `projectConfigPath == globalConfigPath`, `check()` skips the project pass with the note `project config resolves to the global file — skipped: …`.

### Test Coverage

- `test/cli/transcript_answer_once_test.dart` (new): 4 cases driving a real `TranscriptMarkdown` through the gh-1573 commit sequence (fence closed in a grown tail, rollback, mid-tail service traffic); each asserts the answer body and every table row appear **exactly once** — all 4 verified RED on the pre-fix code, GREEN after.
- `test/config/config_service_test.dart`: `cwd == home` case — RED pre-fix (user-only keys warned as dead config), GREEN after.
- Targeted suites re-run green after the fix: `ansi_markdown_test`, `transcript_answer_once_test`, `tui_chrome_test`, `transcript_table_render_test`, `fa_tui_boot_output_coalesce_test`, `fa_tui_test`, `transcript_markdown_perf_test`, `resume_perf_503_test`, all of `test/config/` (493 tests total across these).
- Full `dart test` suite: see final result below (job `sh-123-hn65f29u1o1o5uiei`).

### Notes

- No public API changes; `_WalkResult` gained the seed fields (private class).
- `fa config path` still lists the coincident file under both labels by design — the check pass no longer double-validates it.

- Full `dart test` suite: see final result below (job `sh-123-hn65f29u1o1o5uiei`).

### Notes

- No public API changes; `_WalkResult` gained the seed fields (private class).
- `fa config path` still lists the coincident file under both labels by design — the check pass no longer double-validates it.

- **PR #**: 1586
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1586
- **Title**: gh-1573 [BUG] TUI: final assistant answer rendered 3-4 times after a background bash job / btw notices
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1573` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 4
- **Additions**: +373
- **Deletions**: -9
- **Created**: 2026-10-13T10:39:39Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-13T20:18:01Z

## PR Description

Closes #1573
### Root Cause

- `TranscriptMarkdown._rebuild()` re-parsed an appended tail **without the open-block state latched at the commit boundary** (`lib/src/cli/ansi_markdown.dart`). A fence/table whose opener was already committed left its closing line context-less in the tail, so it fell through the in-fence early-out and was emitted again as plain top-level markdown. Each subsequent status `sendOutput` (background-job notices, `/work · Ntok` lines) repeated the commit and grew the duplicate tail — 3–4 copies of the final answer.
- Secondary (low-priority item in the ticket): `fa config check` with `cwd=~` resolved the project scope to `~/.fah/config.yaml` itself and ran the project pass over the same bytes twice, warning every user-only key (`provider`, `model`, `baseUrl`, …) as "dead config".

### Fix

- `lib/src/cli/ansi_markdown.dart`: latch `_pendingFence` / table style / pending-table state at every `_commitTo()` boundary; seed `_walk()` from it and carry per-step block state; grown-tail rollback now rebuilds from the boundary **with the latched seed**, so the closing line is consumed as a block close instead of re-emitted; `_viewRows` is `boundaryRows + tailRows` — never appended onto stale rows.
- `lib/src/config/config_service.dart`: when `projectConfigPath == globalConfigPath`, `check()` skips the project pass with the note `project config resolves to the global file — skipped: …`.

### Test Coverage

- `test/cli/transcript_answer_once_test.dart` (new): 4 cases driving a real `TranscriptMarkdown` through the gh-1573 commit sequence (fence closed in a grown tail, rollback, mid-tail service traffic); each asserts the answer body and every table row appear **exactly once** — all 4 verified RED on the pre-fix code, GREEN after.
- `test/config/config_service_test.dart`: `cwd == home` case — RED pre-fix (user-only keys warned as dead config), GREEN after.
- Targeted suites re-run green after the fix: `ansi_markdown_test`, `transcript_answer_once_test`, `tui_chrome_test`, `transcript_table_render_test`, `fa_tui_boot_output_coalesce_test`, `fa_tui_test`, `transcript_markdown_perf_test`, `resume_perf_503_test`, all of `test/config/` (493 tests total across these).
- Full `dart test` suite: see final result below (job `sh-123-hn65f29u1o1o5uiei`).

### Notes

- No public API changes; `_WalkResult` gained the seed fields (private class).
- `fa config path` still lists the coincident file under both labels by design — the check pass no longer double-validates it.

# pr-1586: gh-1573 [BUG] TUI: final assistant answer rendered 3-4 times after a background bash job / btw notices

## Description

Closes #1573
### Root Cause

- `TranscriptMarkdown._rebuild()` re-parsed an appended tail **without the open-block state latched at the commit boundary** (`lib/src/cli/ansi_markdown.dart`). A fence/table whose opener was already committed left its closing line context-less in the tail, so it fell through the in-fence early-out and was emitted again as plain top-level markdown. Each subsequent status `sendOutput` (background-job notices, `/work · Ntok` lines) repeated the commit and grew the duplicate tail — 3–4 copies of the final answer.
- Secondary (low-priority item in the ticket): `fa config check` with `cwd=~` resolved the project scope to `~/.fah/config.yaml` itself and ran the project pass over the same bytes twice, warning every user-only key (`provider`, `model`, `baseUrl`, …) as "dead config".

### Fix

- `lib/src/cli/ansi_markdown.dart`: latch `_pendingFence` / table style / pending-table state at every `_commitTo()` boundary; seed `_walk()` from it and carry per-step block state; grown-tail rollback now rebuilds from the boundary **with the latched seed**, so the closing line is consumed as a block close instead of re-emitted; `_viewRows` is `boundaryRows + tailRows` — never appended onto stale rows.
- `lib/src/config/config_service.dart`: when `projectConfigPath == globalConfigPath`, `check()` skips the project pass with the note `project config resolves to the global file — skipped: …`.

### Test Coverage

- `test/cli/transcript_answer_once_test.dart` (new): 4 cases driving a real `TranscriptMarkdown` through the gh-1573 commit sequence (fence closed in a grown tail, rollback, mid-tail service traffic); each asserts the answer body and every table row appear **exactly once** — all 4 verified RED on the pre-fix code, GREEN after.
- `test/config/config_service_test.dart`: `cwd == home` case — RED pre-fix (user-only keys warned as dead config), GREEN after.
- Targeted suites re-run green after the fix: `ansi_markdown_test`, `transcript_answer_once_test`, `tui_chrome_test`, `transcript_table_render_test`, `fa_tui_boot_output_coalesce_test`, `fa_tui_test`, `transcript_markdown_perf_test`, `resume_perf_503_test`, all of `test/config/` (493 tests total across these).
- Full `dart test` suite: see final result below (job `sh-123-hn65f29u1o1o5uiei`).

### Notes

- No public API changes; `_WalkResult` gained the seed fields (private class).
- `fa config path` still lists the coincident file under both labels by design — the check pass no longer double-validates it.

## PR Description

Closes #1573
### Root Cause

- `TranscriptMarkdown._rebuild()` re-parsed an appended tail **without the open-block state latched at the commit boundary** (`lib/src/cli/ansi_markdown.dart`). A fence/table whose opener was already committed left its closing line context-less in the tail, so it fell through the in-fence early-out and was emitted again as plain top-level markdown. Each subsequent status `sendOutput` (background-job notices, `/work · Ntok` lines) repeated the commit and grew the duplicate tail — 3–4 copies of the final answer.
- Secondary (low-priority item in the ticket): `fa config check` with `cwd=~` resolved the project scope to `~/.fah/config.yaml` itself and ran the project pass over the same bytes twice, warning every user-only key (`provider`, `model`, `baseUrl`, …) as "dead config".

### Fix

- `lib/src/cli/ansi_markdown.dart`: latch `_pendingFence` / table style / pending-table state at every `_commitTo()` boundary; seed `_walk()` from it and carry per-step block state; grown-tail rollback now rebuilds from the boundary **with the latched seed**, so the closing line is consumed as a block close instead of re-emitted; `_viewRows` is `boundaryRows + tailRows` — never appended onto stale rows.

# pr-1586: gh-1573 [BUG] TUI: final assistant answer rendered 3-4 times after a background bash job / btw notices

## Description

Closes #1573
### Root Cause

- `TranscriptMarkdown._rebuild()` re-parsed an appended tail **without the open-block state latched at the commit boundary** (`lib/src/cli/ansi_markdown.dart`). A fence/table whose opener was already committed left its closing line context-less in the tail, so it fell through the in-fence early-out and was emitted again as plain top-level markdown. Each subsequent status `sendOutput` (background-job notices, `/work · Ntok` lines) repeated the commit and grew the duplicate tail — 3–4 copies of the final answer.
- Secondary (low-priority item in the ticket): `fa config check` with `cwd=~` resolved the project scope to `~/.fah/config.yaml` itself and ran the project pass over the same bytes twice, warning every user-only key (`provider`, `model`, `baseUrl`, …) as "dead config".

### Fix

- `lib/src/cli/ansi_markdown.dart`: latch `_pendingFence` / table style / pending-table state at every `_commitTo()` boundary; seed `_walk()` from it and carry per-step block state; grown-tail rollback now rebuilds from the boundary **with the latched seed**, so the closing line is consumed as a block close instead of re-emitted; `_viewRows` is `boundaryRows + tailRows` — never appended onto stale rows.
- `lib/src/config/config_service.dart`: when `projectConfigPath == globalConfigPath`, `check()` skips the project pass with the note `project config resolves to the global file — skipped: …`.

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1586
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1586
- **Title**: gh-1573 [BUG] TUI: final assistant answer rendered 3-4 times after a background bash job / btw notices
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1573` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 4
- **Additions**: +373
- **Deletions**: -9
- **Created**: 2026-10-13T10:39:39Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-13T20:18:01Z

## PR Description

Closes #1573
### Root Cause

- `TranscriptMarkdown._rebuild()` re-parsed an appended tail **without the open-block state latched at the commit boundary** (`lib/src/cli/ansi_markdown.dart`). A fence/table whose opener was already committed left its closing line context-less in the tail, so it fell through the in-fence early-out and was emitted again as plain top-level markdown. Each subsequent status `sendOutput` (background-job notices, `/work · Ntok` lines) repeated the commit and grew the duplicate tail — 3–4 copies of the final answer.
- Secondary (low-priority item in the ticket): `fa config check` with `cwd=~` resolved the project scope to `~/.fah/config.yaml` itself and ran the project pass over the same bytes twice, warning every user-only key (`provider`, `model`, `baseUrl`, …) as "dead config".

### Fix

- `lib/src/cli/ansi_markdown.dart`: latch `_pendingFence` / table style / pending-table state at every `_commitTo()` boundary; seed `_walk()` from it and carry per-step block state; grown-tail rollback now rebuilds from the boundary **with the latched seed**, so the closing line is consumed as a block close instead of re-emitted; `_viewRows` is `boundaryRows + tailRows` — never appended onto stale rows.
- `lib/src/config/config_service.dart`: when `projectConfigPath == globalConfigPath`, `check()` skips the project pass with the note `project config resolves to the global file — skipped: …`.

### Test Coverage

- `test/cli/transcript_answer_once_test.dart` (new): 4 cases driving a real `TranscriptMarkdown` through the gh-1573 commit sequence (fence closed in a grown tail, rollback, mid-tail service traffic); each asserts the answer body and every table row appear **exactly once** — all 4 verified RED on the pre-fix code, GREEN after.
- `test/config/config_service_test.dart`: `cwd == home` case — RED pre-fix (user-only keys warned as dead config), GREEN after.
- Targeted suites re-run green after the fix: `ansi_markdown_test`, `transcript_answer_once_test`, `tui_chrome_test`, `transcript_table_render_test`, `fa_tui_boot_output_coalesce_test`, `fa_tui_test`, `transcript_markdown_perf_test`, `resume_perf_503_test`, all of `test/config/` (493 tests total across these).
- Full `dart test` suite: see final result below (job `sh-123-hn65f29u1o1o5uiei`).

### Notes

- No public API changes; `_WalkResult` gained the seed fields (private class).
- `fa config path` still lists the coincident file under both labels by design — the check pass no longer double-validates it.

# pr-1586: gh-1573 [BUG] TUI: final assistant answer rendered 3-4 times after a background bash job / btw notices

## Description

Closes #1573
### Root Cause

- `TranscriptMarkdown._rebuild()` re-parsed an appended tail **without the open-block state latched at the commit boundary** (`lib/src/cli/ansi_markdown.dart`). A fence/table whose opener was already committed left its closing line context-less in the tail, so it fell through the in-fence early-out and was emitted again as plain top-level markdown. Each subsequent status `sendOutput` (background-job notices, `/work · Ntok` lines) repeated the commit and grew the duplicate tail — 3–4 copies of the final answer.
- Secondary (low-priority item in the ticket): `fa config check` with `cwd=~` resolved the project scope to `~/.fah/config.yaml` itself and ran the project pass over the same bytes twice, warning every user-only key (`provider`, `model`, `baseUrl`, …) as "dead config".

### Fix

- `lib/src/cli/ansi_markdown.dart`: latch `_pendingFence` / table style / pending-table state at every `_commitTo()` boundary; seed `_walk()` from it and carry per-step block state; grown-tail rollback now rebuilds from the boundary **with the latched seed**, so the closing line is consumed as a block close instead of re-emitted; `_viewRows` is `boundaryRows + tailRows` — never appended onto stale rows.
- `lib/src/config/config_service.dart`: when `projectConfigPath == globalConfigPath`, `check()` skips the project pass with the note `project config resolves to the global file — skipped: …`.

### Test Coverage

- `test/cli/transcript_answer_once_test.dart` (new): 4 cases driving a real `TranscriptMarkdown` through the gh-1573 commit sequence (fence closed in a grown tail, rollback, mid-tail service traffic); each asserts the answer body and every table row appear **exactly once** — all 4 verified RED on the pre-fix code, GREEN after.
- `test/config/config_service_test.dart`: `cwd == home` case — RED pre-fix (user-only keys warned as dead config), GREEN after.
- Targeted suites re-run green after the fix: `ansi_markdown_test`, `transcript_answer_once_test`, `tui_chrome_test`, `transcript_table_render_test`, `fa_tui_boot_output_coalesce_test`, `fa_tui_test`, `transcript_markdown_perf_test`, `resume_perf_503_test`, all of `test/config/` (493 tests total across these).
- Full `dart test` suite: see final result below (job `sh-123-hn65f29u1o1o5uiei`).

### Notes

- No public API changes; `_WalkResult` gained the seed fields (private class).
- `fa config path` still lists the coincident file under both labels by design — the check pass no longer double-validates it.

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1586
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1586
- **Title**: gh-1573 [BUG] TUI: final assistant answer rendered 3-4 times after a background bash job / btw notices
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1573` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 4
- **Additions**: +373
- **Deletions**: -9
- **Created**: 2026-10-13T10:39:39Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-13T20:18:01Z

## PR Description

Closes #1573
### Root Cause

- `TranscriptMarkdown._rebuild()` re-parsed an appended tail **without the open-block state latched at the commit boundary** (`lib/src/cli/ansi_markdown.dart`). A fence/table whose opener was already committed left its closing line context-less in the tail, so it fell through the in-fence early-out and was emitted again as plain top-level markdown. Each subsequent status `sendOutput` (background-job notices, `/work · Ntok` lines) repeated the commit and grew the duplicate tail — 3–4 copies of the final answer.
- Secondary (low-priority item in the ticket): `fa config check` with `cwd=~` resolved the project scope to `~/.fah/config.yaml` itself and ran the project pass over the same bytes twice, warning every user-only key (`provider`, `model`, `baseUrl`, …) as "dead config".

### Fix

- `lib/src/cli/ansi_markdown.dart`: latch `_pendingFence` / table style / pending-table state at every `_commitTo()` boundary; seed `_walk()` from it and carry per-step block state; grown-tail rollback now rebuilds from the boundary **with the latched seed**, so the closing line is consumed as a block close instead of re-emitted; `_viewRows` is `boundaryRows + tailRows` — never appended onto stale rows.
- `lib/src/config/config_service.dart`: when `projectConfigPath == globalConfigPath`, `check()` skips the project pass with the note `project config resolves to the global file — skipped: …`.

### Test Coverage

- `test/cli/transcript_answer_once_test.dart` (new): 4 cases driving a real `TranscriptMarkdown` through the gh-1573 commit sequence (fence closed in a grown tail, rollback, mid-tail service traffic); each asserts the answer body and every table row appear **exactly once** — all 4 verified RED on the pre-fix code, GREEN after.
- `test/config/config_service_test.dart`: `cwd == home` case — RED pre-fix (user-only keys warned as dead config), GREEN after.
- Targeted suites re-run green after the fix: `ansi_markdown_test`, `transcript_answer_once_test`, `tui_chrome_test`, `transcript_table_render_test`, `fa_tui_boot_output_coalesce_test`, `fa_tui_test`, `transcript_markdown_perf_test`, `resume_perf_503_test`, all of `test/config/` (493 tests total across these).
- Full `dart test` suite: see final result below (job `sh-123-hn65f29u1o1o5uiei`).

### Notes

- No public API changes; `_WalkResult` gained the seed fields (private class).
- `fa config path` still lists the coincident file under both labels by design — the check pass no longer double-validates it.

- `TranscriptMarkdown._rebuild()` re-parsed an appended tail **without the open-block state latched at the commit boundary** (`lib/src/cli/ansi_markdown.dart`). A fence/table whose opener was already committed left its closing line context-less in the tail, so it fell through the in-fence early-out and was emitted again as plain top-level markdown. Each subsequent status `sendOutput` (background-job notices, `/work · Ntok` lines) repeated the commit and grew the duplicate tail — 3–4 copies of the final answer.
- Secondary (low-priority item in the ticket): `fa config check` with `cwd=~` resolved the project scope to `~/.fah/config.yaml` itself and ran the project pass over the same bytes twice, warning every user-only key (`provider`, `model`, `baseUrl`, …) as "dead config".

### Fix

- `lib/src/cli/ansi_markdown.dart`: latch `_pendingFence` / table style / pending-table state at every `_commitTo()` boundary; seed `_walk()` from it and carry per-step block state; grown-tail rollback now rebuilds from the boundary **with the latched seed**, so the closing line is consumed as a block close instead of re-emitted; `_viewRows` is `boundaryRows + tailRows` — never appended onto stale rows.
- `lib/src/config/config_service.dart`: when `projectConfigPath == globalConfigPath`, `check()` skips the project pass with the note `project config resolves to the global file — skipped: …`.

### Test Coverage

- `test/cli/transcript_answer_once_test.dart` (new): 4 cases driving a real `TranscriptMarkdown` through the gh-1573 commit sequence (fence closed in a grown tail, rollback, mid-tail service traffic); each asserts the answer body and every table row appear **exactly once** — all 4 verified RED on the pre-fix code, GREEN after.
- `test/config/config_service_test.dart`: `cwd == home` case — RED pre-fix (user-only keys warned as dead config), GREEN after.
- Targeted suites re-run green after the fix: `ansi_markdown_test`, `transcript_answer_once_test`, `tui_chrome_test`, `transcript_table_render_test`, `fa_tui_boot_output_coalesce_test`, `fa_tui_test`, `transcript_markdown_perf_test`, `resume_perf_503_test`, all of `test/config/` (493 tests total across these).
- Full `dart test` suite: see final result below (job `sh-123-hn65f29u1o1o5uiei`).

### Notes

- No public API changes; `_WalkResult` gained the seed fields (private class).
- `fa config path` still lists the coincident file under both labels by design — the check pass no longer double-validates it.

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1586
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1586
- **Title**: gh-1573 [BUG] TUI: final assistant answer rendered 3-4 times after a background bash job / btw notices
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1573` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 4
- **Additions**: +373
- **Deletions**: -9
- **Created**: 2026-10-13T10:39:39Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-13T20:18:01Z

## PR Description

Closes #1573
### Root Cause

- `TranscriptMarkdown._rebuild()` re-parsed an appended tail **without the open-block state latched at the commit boundary** (`lib/src/cli/ansi_markdown.dart`). A fence/table whose opener was already committed left its closing line context-less in the tail, so it fell through the in-fence early-out and was emitted again as plain top-level markdown. Each subsequent status `sendOutput` (background-job notices, `/work · Ntok` lines) repeated the commit and grew the duplicate tail — 3–4 copies of the final answer.
- Secondary (low-priority item in the ticket): `fa config check` with `cwd=~` resolved the project scope to `~/.fah/config.yaml` itself and ran the project pass over the same bytes twice, warning every user-only key (`provider`, `model`, `baseUrl`, …) as "dead config".

### Fix

- `lib/src/cli/ansi_markdown.dart`: latch `_pendingFence` / table style / pending-table state at every `_commitTo()` boundary; seed `_walk()` from it and carry per-step block state; grown-tail rollback now rebuilds from the boundary **with the latched seed**, so the closing line is consumed as a block close instead of re-emitted; `_viewRows` is `boundaryRows + tailRows` — never appended onto stale rows.
- `lib/src/config/config_service.dart`: when `projectConfigPath == globalConfigPath`, `check()` skips the project pass with the note `project config resolves to the global file — skipped: …`.

### Test Coverage

- `test/cli/transcript_answer_once_test.dart` (new): 4 cases driving a real `TranscriptMarkdown` through the gh-1573 commit sequence (fence closed in a grown tail, rollback, mid-tail service traffic); each asserts the answer body and every table row appear **exactly once** — all 4 verified RED on the pre-fix code, GREEN after.
- `test/config/config_service_test.dart`: `cwd == home` case — RED pre-fix (user-only keys warned as dead config), GREEN after.
- Targeted suites re-run green after the fix: `ansi_markdown_test`, `transcript_answer_once_test`, `tui_chrome_test`, `transcript_table_render_test`, `fa_tui_boot_output_coalesce_test`, `fa_tui_test`, `transcript_markdown_perf_test`, `resume_perf_503_test`, all of `test/config/` (493 tests total across these).
- Full `dart test` suite: see final result below (job `sh-123-hn65f29u1o1o5uiei`).

### Notes

- No public API changes; `_WalkResult` gained the seed fields (private class).
- `fa config path` still lists the coincident file under both labels by design — the check pass no longer double-validates it.

## Review Threads (Inline Comments)

### Thread 1 — `lib/src/config/config_service.dart`

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-13):
💡 **SUGGESTION: path-equality guard misses symlinked / trailing-slash spellings**

The `cwd == home` guard is raw string equality. `getcwd`-derived cwd values are canonical, but `homeDir` often comes from `$HOME`, which can carry a trailing slash or a symlinked spelling (macOS: `cwd=/private/tmp` vs `HOME=/tmp`; `HOME=/home/user/` on some PAM setups). In those shapes the guard misses, and `check()` falls back to the old double-validate + false "dead config" warning this PR fixes.

Consider normalizing both sides before comparing, e.g. strip a trailing `/` (and/or compare `File.path` canonicalization if a lightweight helper already exists in the codebase):

```dart
String _normalizeDir(String p) =>
    p.length > 1 && p.endsWith('/') ? p.substring(0, p.length - 1) : p;

if (globalPath != null &&
    projectPath == _normalizeDir(globalPath)) { ... }
```

Low real-world risk (the reported `cwd=~` shape is fully covered), so this is polish — not a merge blocker.

---

### Thread 2 — `lib/src/config/config_service.dart`

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-13):
💡 **SUGGESTION: `dart format` would collapse this line — run the formatter**

The rename `projectConfigPath` → `projectPath` shortened this line below the 80-col wrap budget, so `dart format` now wants it on one line:

```dart
// current
report.notes.add(
  'project config absent (defaults apply): $projectPath',
);
// dart format output
report.notes.add('project config absent (defaults apply): $projectPath');
```

The repo has no CI format gate (only `analyze` + tests + CRAP), and the pre-commit hook self-heals staged files, so this won't break anything — but running `dart format lib/src/config/config_service.dart` before the next push keeps the tree formatter-clean.

---

### Thread 3 — `test/config/config_service_test.dart`

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-13):
💡 **SUGGESTION: redundant first `writeFile` — the outer `env` is never read by `homeService`**

This write goes through the `setUp`-scoped `env` (cwd `/work`), but the service under test is `homeService` (built on the fresh `homeEnv`, cwd `/home`), and the same global file is re-written via `homeEnv` two lines below. The first write is dead setup — the test passes identically without it:

```dart
test('cwd == home: ...', () async {
  final homeEnv = MemoryExecutionEnv(cwd: '/home');
  final homeService = ConfigService(env: homeEnv, homeDir: '/home');
  await homeEnv.writeFile(_globalConfig, _validGlobal);
  final report = await checkOrThrow(homeService);
  ...
});
```

Purely cosmetic; behavior is already verified correct (RED on pre-fix code, GREEN after).

---

### Thread 4 — `lib/src/cli/ansi_markdown.dart`

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-13):
💡 **SUGGESTION: pending-table bookkeeping loop is now duplicated between `_walk` and `_rebuild`**

# pr-1586: gh-1573 [BUG] TUI: final assistant answer rendered 3-4 times after a background bash job / btw notices

## Description

Closes #1573
### Root Cause

- `TranscriptMarkdown._rebuild()` re-parsed an appended tail **without the open-block state latched at the commit boundary** (`lib/src/cli/ansi_markdown.dart`). A fence/table whose opener was already committed left its closing line context-less in the tail, so it fell through the in-fence early-out and was emitted again as plain top-level markdown. Each subsequent status `sendOutput` (background-job notices, `/work · Ntok` lines) repeated the commit and grew the duplicate tail — 3–4 copies of the final answer.
- Secondary (low-priority item in the ticket): `fa config check` with `cwd=~` resolved the project scope to `~/.fah/config.yaml` itself and ran the project pass over the same bytes twice, warning every user-only key (`provider`, `model`, `baseUrl`, …) as "dead config".

### Fix

- `lib/src/cli/ansi_markdown.dart`: latch `_pendingFence` / table style / pending-table state at every `_commitTo()` boundary; seed `_walk()` from it and carry per-step block state; grown-tail rollback now rebuilds from the boundary **with the latched seed**, so the closing line is consumed as a block close instead of re-emitted; `_viewRows` is `boundaryRows + tailRows` — never appended onto stale rows.
- `lib/src/config/config_service.dart`: when `projectConfigPath == globalConfigPath`, `check()` skips the project pass with the note `project config resolves to the global file — skipped: …`.

### Test Coverage

- `test/cli/transcript_answer_once_test.dart` (new): 4 cases driving a real `TranscriptMarkdown` through the gh-1573 commit sequence (fence closed in a grown tail, rollback, mid-tail service traffic); each asserts the answer body and every table row appear **exactly once** — all 4 verified RED on the pre-fix code, GREEN after.
- `test/config/config_service_test.dart`: `cwd == home` case — RED pre-fix (user-only keys warned as dead config), GREEN after.
- Targeted suites re-run green after the fix: `ansi_markdown_test`, `transcript_answer_once_test`, `tui_chrome_test`, `transcript_table_render_test`, `fa_tui_boot_output_coalesce_test`, `fa_tui_test`, `transcript_markdown_perf_test`, `resume_perf_503_test`, all of `test/config/` (493 tests total across these).
- Full `dart test` suite: see final result below (job `sh-123-hn65f29u1o1o5uiei`).

### Notes

- No public API changes; `_WalkResult` gained the seed fields (private class).
- `fa config path` still lists the coincident file under both labels by design — the check pass no longer double-validates it.

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1586
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1586
- **Title**: gh-1573 [BUG] TUI: final assistant answer rendered 3-4 times after a background bash job / btw notices
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1573` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 4
- **Additions**: +373
- **Deletions**: -9
- **Created**: 2026-10-13T10:39:39Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-13T20:18:01Z

## PR Description

Closes #1573
### Root Cause

- `TranscriptMarkdown._rebuild()` re-parsed an appended tail **without the open-block state latched at the commit boundary** (`lib/src/cli/ansi_markdown.dart`). A fence/table whose opener was already committed left its closing line context-less in the tail, so it fell through the in-fence early-out and was emitted again as plain top-level markdown. Each subsequent status `sendOutput` (background-job notices, `/work · Ntok` lines) repeated the commit and grew the duplicate tail — 3–4 copies of the final answer.
- Secondary (low-priority item in the ticket): `fa config check` with `cwd=~` resolved the project scope to `~/.fah/config.yaml` itself and ran the project pass over the same bytes twice, warning every user-only key (`provider`, `model`, `baseUrl`, …) as "dead config".

### Fix

- `lib/src/cli/ansi_markdown.dart`: latch `_pendingFence` / table style / pending-table state at every `_commitTo()` boundary; seed `_walk()` from it and carry per-step block state; grown-tail rollback now rebuilds from the boundary **with the latched seed**, so the closing line is consumed as a block close instead of re-emitted; `_viewRows` is `boundaryRows + tailRows` — never appended onto stale rows.
- `lib/src/config/config_service.dart`: when `projectConfigPath == globalConfigPath`, `check()` skips the project pass with the note `project config resolves to the global file — skipped: …`.

### Test Coverage

- `test/cli/transcript_answer_once_test.dart` (new): 4 cases driving a real `TranscriptMarkdown` through the gh-1573 commit sequence (fence closed in a grown tail, rollback, mid-tail service traffic); each asserts the answer body and every table row appear **exactly once** — all 4 verified RED on the pre-fix code, GREEN after.
- `test/config/config_service_test.dart`: `cwd == home` case — RED pre-fix (user-only keys warned as dead config), GREEN after.
- Targeted suites re-run green after the fix: `ansi_markdown_test`, `transcript_answer_once_test`, `tui_chrome_test`, `transcript_table_render_test`, `fa_tui_boot_output_coalesce_test`, `fa_tui_test`, `transcript_markdown_perf_test`, `resume_perf_503_test`, all of `test/config/` (493 tests total across these).
- Full `dart test` suite: see final result below (job `sh-123-hn65f29u1o1o5uiei`).

### Notes

- No public API changes; `_WalkResult` gained the seed fields (private class).
- `fa config path` still lists the coincident file under both labels by design — the check pass no longer double-validates it.

# pr-1586: gh-1573 [BUG] TUI: final assistant answer rendered 3-4 times after a background bash job / btw notices

## Description

Closes #1573
### Root Cause

- `TranscriptMarkdown._rebuild()` re-parsed an appended tail **without the open-block state latched at the commit boundary** (`lib/src/cli/ansi_markdown.dart`). A fence/table whose opener was already committed left its closing line context-less in the tail, so it fell through the in-fence early-out and was emitted again as plain top-level markdown. Each subsequent status `sendOutput` (background-job notices, `/work · Ntok` lines) repeated the commit and grew the duplicate tail — 3–4 copies of the final answer.
- Secondary (low-priority item in the ticket): `fa config check` with `cwd=~` resolved the project scope to `~/.fah/config.yaml` itself and ran the project pass over the same bytes twice, warning every user-only key (`provider`, `model`, `baseUrl`, …) as "dead config".

### Fix

- `lib/src/cli/ansi_markdown.dart`: latch `_pendingFence` / table style / pending-table state at every `_commitTo()` boundary; seed `_walk()` from it and carry per-step block state; grown-tail rollback now rebuilds from the boundary **with the latched seed**, so the closing line is consumed as a block close instead of re-emitted; `_viewRows` is `boundaryRows + tailRows` — never appended onto stale rows.
- `lib/src/config/config_service.dart`: when `projectConfigPath == globalConfigPath`, `check()` skips the project pass with the note `project config resolves to the global file — skipped: …`.

### Test Coverage

- `test/cli/transcript_answer_once_test.dart` (new): 4 cases driving a real `TranscriptMarkdown` through the gh-1573 commit sequence (fence closed in a grown tail, rollback, mid-tail service traffic); each asserts the answer body and every table row appear **exactly once** — all 4 verified RED on the pre-fix code, GREEN after.
- `test/config/config_service_test.dart`: `cwd == home` case — RED pre-fix (user-only keys warned as dead config), GREEN after.
- Targeted suites re-run green after the fix: `ansi_markdown_test`, `transcript_answer_once_test`, `tui_chrome_test`, `transcript_table_render_test`, `fa_tui_boot_output_coalesce_test`, `fa_tui_test`, `transcript_markdown_perf_test`, `resume_perf_503_test`, all of `test/config/` (493 tests total across these).
- Full `dart test` suite: see final result below (job `sh-123-hn65f29u1o1o5uiei`).

### Notes

- No public API changes; `_WalkResult` gained the seed fields (private class).
- `fa config path` still lists the coincident file under both labels by design — the check pass no longer double-validates it.

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1586
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1586
- **Title**: gh-1573 [BUG] TUI: final assistant answer rendered 3-4 times after a background bash job / btw notices
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1573` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 4
- **Additions**: +373
- **Deletions**: -9
- **Created**: 2026-10-13T10:39:39Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-13T20:18:01Z

## PR Description

Closes #1573
### Root Cause

- `TranscriptMarkdown._rebuild()` re-parsed an appended tail **without the open-block state latched at the commit boundary** (`lib/src/cli/ansi_markdown.dart`). A fence/table whose opener was already committed left its closing line context-less in the tail, so it fell through the in-fence early-out and was emitted again as plain top-level markdown. Each subsequent status `sendOutput` (background-job notices, `/work · Ntok` lines) repeated the commit and grew the duplicate tail — 3–4 copies of the final answer.
- Secondary (low-priority item in the ticket): `fa config check` with `cwd=~` resolved the project scope to `~/.fah/config.yaml` itself and ran the project pass over the same bytes twice, warning every user-only key (`provider`, `model`, `baseUrl`, …) as "dead config".

### Fix

- `lib/src/cli/ansi_markdown.dart`: latch `_pendingFence` / table style / pending-table state at every `_commitTo()` boundary; seed `_walk()` from it and carry per-step block state; grown-tail rollback now rebuilds from the boundary **with the latched seed**, so the closing line is consumed as a block close instead of re-emitted; `_viewRows` is `boundaryRows + tailRows` — never appended onto stale rows.
- `lib/src/config/config_service.dart`: when `projectConfigPath == globalConfigPath`, `check()` skips the project pass with the note `project config resolves to the global file — skipped: …`.

### Test Coverage

- `test/cli/transcript_answer_once_test.dart` (new): 4 cases driving a real `TranscriptMarkdown` through the gh-1573 commit sequence (fence closed in a grown tail, rollback, mid-tail service traffic); each asserts the answer body and every table row appear **exactly once** — all 4 verified RED on the pre-fix code, GREEN after.
- `test/config/config_service_test.dart`: `cwd == home` case — RED pre-fix (user-only keys warned as dead config), GREEN after.
- Targeted suites re-run green after the fix: `ansi_markdown_test`, `transcript_answer_once_test`, `tui_chrome_test`, `transcript_table_render_test`, `fa_tui_boot_output_coalesce_test`, `fa_tui_test`, `transcript_markdown_perf_test`, `resume_perf_503_test`, all of `test/config/` (493 tests total across these).
- Full `dart test` suite: see final result below (job `sh-123-hn65f29u1o1o5uiei`).

### Notes

- No public API changes; `_WalkResult` gained the seed fields (private class).
- `fa config path` still lists the coincident file under both labels by design — the check pass no longer double-validates it.

# pr-1586: gh-1573 [BUG] TUI: final assistant answer rendered 3-4 times after a background bash job / btw notices

## Description

Closes #1573
### Root Cause

- `TranscriptMarkdown._rebuild()` re-parsed an appended tail **without the open-block state latched at the commit boundary** (`lib/src/cli/ansi_markdown.dart`). A fence/table whose opener was already committed left its closing line context-less in the tail, so it fell through the in-fence early-out and was emitted again as plain top-level markdown. Each subsequent status `sendOutput` (background-job notices, `/work · Ntok` lines) repeated the commit and grew the duplicate tail — 3–4 copies of the final answer.
- Secondary (low-priority item in the ticket): `fa config check` with `cwd=~` resolved the project scope to `~/.fah/config.yaml` itself and ran the project pass over the same bytes twice, warning every user-only key (`provider`, `model`, `baseUrl`, …) as "dead config".

### Fix

- `lib/src/cli/ansi_markdown.dart`: latch `_pendingFence` / table style / pending-table state at every `_commitTo()` boundary; seed `_walk()` from it and carry per-step block state; grown-tail rollback now rebuilds from the boundary **with the latched seed**, so the closing line is consumed as a block close instead of re-emitted; `_viewRows` is `boundaryRows + tailRows` — never appended onto stale rows.
- `lib/src/config/config_service.dart`: when `projectConfigPath == globalConfigPath`, `check()` skips the project pass with the note `project config resolves to the global file — skipped: …`.

### Test Coverage

- `test/cli/transcript_answer_once_test.dart` (new): 4 cases driving a real `TranscriptMarkdown` through the gh-1573 commit sequence (fence closed in a grown tail, rollback, mid-tail service traffic); each asserts the answer body and every table row appear **exactly once** — all 4 verified RED on the pre-fix code, GREEN after.
- `test/config/config_service_test.dart`: `cwd == home` case — RED pre-fix (user-only keys warned as dead config), GREEN after.
- Targeted suites re-run green after the fix: `ansi_markdown_test`, `transcript_answer_once_test`, `tui_chrome_test`, `transcript_table_render_test`, `fa_tui_boot_output_coalesce_test`, `fa_tui_test`, `transcript_markdown_perf_test`, `resume_perf_503_test`, all of `test/config/` (493 tests total across these).
- Full `dart test` suite: see final result below (job `sh-123-hn65f29u1o1o5uiei`).

### Notes

- No public API changes; `_WalkResult` gained the seed fields (private class).
- `fa config path` still lists the coincident file under both labels by design — the check pass no longer double-validates it.

## PR Description

Closes #1573
### Root Cause

- `TranscriptMarkdown._rebuild()` re-parsed an appended tail **without the open-block state latched at the commit boundary** (`lib/src/cli/ansi_markdown.dart`). A fence/table whose opener was already committed left its closing line context-less in the tail, so it fell through the in-fence early-out and was emitted again as plain top-level markdown. Each subsequent status `sendOutput` (background-job notices, `/work · Ntok` lines) repeated the commit and grew the duplicate tail — 3–4 copies of the final answer.
- Secondary (low-priority item in the ticket): `fa config check` with `cwd=~` resolved the project scope to `~/.fah/config.yaml` itself and ran the project pass over the same bytes twice, warning every user-only key (`provider`, `model`, `baseUrl`, …) as "dead config".

### Fix

- No public API changes; `_WalkResult` gained the seed fields (private class).

# pr-1586: gh-1573 [BUG] TUI: final assistant answer rendered 3-4 times after a background bash job / btw notices

## Description

Closes #1573
### Root Cause

- `TranscriptMarkdown._rebuild()` re-parsed an appended tail **without the open-block state latched at the commit boundary** (`lib/src/cli/ansi_markdown.dart`). A fence/table whose opener was already committed left its closing line context-less in the tail, so it fell through the in-fence early-out and was emitted again as plain top-level markdown. Each subsequent status `sendOutput` (background-job notices, `/work · Ntok` lines) repeated the commit and grew the duplicate tail — 3–4 copies of the final answer.
- Secondary (low-priority item in the ticket): `fa config check` with `cwd=~` resolved the project scope to `~/.fah/config.yaml` itself and ran the project pass over the same bytes twice, warning every user-only key (`provider`, `model`, `baseUrl`, …) as "dead config".

### Fix

- `lib/src/cli/ansi_markdown.dart`: latch `_pendingFence` / table style / pending-table state at every `_commitTo()` boundary; seed `_walk()` from it and carry per-step block state; grown-tail rollback now rebuilds from the boundary **with the latched seed**, so the closing line is consumed as a block close instead of re-emitted; `_viewRows` is `boundaryRows + tailRows` — never appended onto stale rows.

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1586
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1586
- **Title**: gh-1573 [BUG] TUI: final assistant answer rendered 3-4 times after a background bash job / btw notices
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1573` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 4
- **Additions**: +373
- **Deletions**: -9
- **Created**: 2026-10-13T10:39:39Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-13T20:18:01Z

## PR Description

Closes #1573
### Root Cause

- `TranscriptMarkdown._rebuild()` re-parsed an appended tail **without the open-block state latched at the commit boundary** (`lib/src/cli/ansi_markdown.dart`). A fence/table whose opener was already committed left its closing line context-less in the tail, so it fell through the in-fence early-out and was emitted again as plain top-level markdown. Each subsequent status `sendOutput` (background-job notices, `/work · Ntok` lines) repeated the commit and grew the duplicate tail — 3–4 copies of the final answer.
- Secondary (low-priority item in the ticket): `fa config check` with `cwd=~` resolved the project scope to `~/.fah/config.yaml` itself and ran the project pass over the same bytes twice, warning every user-only key (`provider`, `model`, `baseUrl`, …) as "dead config".

### Fix

- `lib/src/cli/ansi_markdown.dart`: latch `_pendingFence` / table style / pending-table state at every `_commitTo()` boundary; seed `_walk()` from it and carry per-step block state; grown-tail rollback now rebuilds from the boundary **with the latched seed**, so the closing line is consumed as a block close instead of re-emitted; `_viewRows` is `boundaryRows + tailRows` — never appended onto stale rows.
- `lib/src/config/config_service.dart`: when `projectConfigPath == globalConfigPath`, `check()` skips the project pass with the note `project config resolves to the global file — skipped: …`.

### Test Coverage

- `test/cli/transcript_answer_once_test.dart` (new): 4 cases driving a real `TranscriptMarkdown` through the gh-1573 commit sequence (fence closed in a grown tail, rollback, mid-tail service traffic); each asserts the answer body and every table row appear **exactly once** — all 4 verified RED on the pre-fix code, GREEN after.
- `test/config/config_service_test.dart`: `cwd == home` case — RED pre-fix (user-only keys warned as dead config), GREEN after.
- Targeted suites re-run green after the fix: `ansi_markdown_test`, `transcript_answer_once_test`, `tui_chrome_test`, `transcript_table_render_test`, `fa_tui_boot_output_coalesce_test`, `fa_tui_test`, `transcript_markdown_perf_test`, `resume_perf_503_test`, all of `test/config/` (493 tests total across these).
- Full `dart test` suite: see final result below (job `sh-123-hn65f29u1o1o5uiei`).

### Notes

- No public API changes; `_WalkResult` gained the seed fields (private class).
- `fa config path` still lists the coincident file under both labels by design — the check pass no longer double-validates it.

# pr-1586: gh-1573 [BUG] TUI: final assistant answer rendered 3-4 times after a background bash job / btw notices

## Description

Closes #1573
### Root Cause

- `TranscriptMarkdown._rebuild()` re-parsed an appended tail **without the open-block state latched at the commit boundary** (`lib/src/cli/ansi_markdown.dart`). A fence/table whose opener was already committed left its closing line context-less in the tail, so it fell through the in-fence early-out and was emitted again as plain top-level markdown. Each subsequent status `sendOutput` (background-job notices, `/work · Ntok` lines) repeated the commit and grew the duplicate tail — 3–4 copies of the final answer.
- Secondary (low-priority item in the ticket): `fa config check` with `cwd=~` resolved the project scope to `~/.fah/config.yaml` itself and ran the project pass over the same bytes twice, warning every user-only key (`provider`, `model`, `baseUrl`, …) as "dead config".

### Fix

- `lib/src/cli/ansi_markdown.dart`: latch `_pendingFence` / table style / pending-table state at every `_commitTo()` boundary; seed `_walk()` from it and carry per-step block state; grown-tail rollback now rebuilds from the boundary **with the latched seed**, so the closing line is consumed as a block close instead of re-emitted; `_viewRows` is `boundaryRows + tailRows` — never appended onto stale rows.
- `lib/src/config/config_service.dart`: when `projectConfigPath == globalConfigPath`, `check()` skips the project pass with the note `project config resolves to the global file — skipped: …`.

### Test Coverage

- `test/cli/transcript_answer_once_test.dart` (new): 4 cases driving a real `TranscriptMarkdown` through the gh-1573 commit sequence (fence closed in a grown tail, rollback, mid-tail service traffic); each asserts the answer body and every table row appear **exactly once** — all 4 verified RED on the pre-fix code, GREEN after.
- `test/config/config_service_test.dart`: `cwd == home` case — RED pre-fix (user-only keys warned as dead config), GREEN after.
- Targeted suites re-run green after the fix: `ansi_markdown_test`, `transcript_answer_once_test`, `tui_chrome_test`, `transcript_table_render_test`, `fa_tui_boot_output_coalesce_test`, `fa_tui_test`, `transcript_markdown_perf_test`, `resume_perf_503_test`, all of `test/config/` (493 tests total across these).
- Full `dart test` suite: see final result below (job `sh-123-hn65f29u1o1o5uiei`).

### Notes

- No public API changes; `_WalkResult` gained the seed fields (private class).
- `fa config path` still lists the coincident file under both labels by design — the check pass no longer double-validates it.

- **State**: open
