## PR Description

Closes #1573
### Root Cause

- `TranscriptMarkdown._rebuild()` re-parsed an appended tail **without the open-block state latched at the commit boundary** (`lib/src/cli/ansi_markdown.dart`). A fence/table whose opener was already committed left its closing line context-less in the tail, so it fell through the in-fence early-out and was emitted again as plain top-level markdown. Each subsequent status `sendOutput` (background-job notices, `/work · Ntok` lines) repeated the commit and grew the duplicate tail — 3–4 copies of the final answer.
- Secondary (low-priority item in the ticket): `fa config check` with `cwd=~` resolved the project scope to `~/.fah/config.yaml` itself and ran the project pass over the same bytes twice, warning every user-only key (`provider`, `model`, `baseUrl`, …) as "dead config".

### Fix

- `lib/src/cli/ansi_markdown.dart`: latch `_pendingFence` / table style / pending-table state at every `_commitTo()` boundary; seed `_walk()` from it and carry per-step block state; grown-tail rollback now rebuilds from the boundary **with the latched seed**, so the closing line is consumed as a block close instead of re-emitted; `_viewRows` is `boundaryRows + tailRows` — never appended onto stale rows.
- `lib/src/config/config_service.dart`: when `projectConfigPath == globalConfigPath`, `check()` skips the project pass with the note `project config resolves to the global file — skipped: …`.

### Test Coverage

- `test/cli/transcript_answer_once_test.dart` (new): 4 cases driving a real `TranscriptMarkdown` through the gh-1573 commit sequence (fence closed in a grown tail, rollback, mid-tail service traffic); each asserts the answer body and every table row appear **exactly once** — all 4 verified RED on the pre-fix code, GREEN after.
- `test/config/config_service_test.dart`: `cwd == home` case — RED pre-fix (user-only keys warned as dead config), GREEN after.
- Targeted suites re-run green after the fix: `ansi_markdown_test`, `transcript_answer_once_test`, `tui_chrome_test`, `transcript_table_render_test`, `fa_tui_boot_output_coalesce_test`, `fa_tui_test`, `transcript_markdown_perf_test`, `resume_perf_503_test`, all of `test/config/` (493 tests total across these).
- Full `dart test` suite: see final result below (job `sh-123-hn65f29u1o1o5uiei`).

### Notes

- No public API changes; `_WalkResult` gained the seed fields (private class).
- `fa config path` still lists the coincident file under both labels by design — the check pass no longer double-validates it.

# pr-1586: gh-1573 [BUG] TUI: final assistant answer rendered 3-4 times after a background bash job / btw notices

## Description

Closes #1573
### Root Cause

- `TranscriptMarkdown._rebuild()` re-parsed an appended tail **without the open-block state latched at the commit boundary** (`lib/src/cli/ansi_markdown.dart`). A fence/table whose opener was already committed left its closing line context-less in the tail, so it fell through the in-fence early-out and was emitted again as plain top-level markdown. Each subsequent status `sendOutput` (background-job notices, `/work · Ntok` lines) repeated the commit and grew the duplicate tail — 3–4 copies of the final answer.
- Secondary (low-priority item in the ticket): `fa config check` with `cwd=~` resolved the project scope to `~/.fah/config.yaml` itself and ran the project pass over the same bytes twice, warning every user-only key (`provider`, `model`, `baseUrl`, …) as "dead config".

### Fix

- `lib/src/cli/ansi_markdown.dart`: latch `_pendingFence` / table style / pending-table state at every `_commitTo()` boundary; seed `_walk()` from it and carry per-step block state; grown-tail rollback now rebuilds from the boundary **with the latched seed**, so the closing line is consumed as a block close instead of re-emitted; `_viewRows` is `boundaryRows + tailRows` — never appended onto stale rows.
- `lib/src/config/config_service.dart`: when `projectConfigPath == globalConfigPath`, `check()` skips the project pass with the note `project config resolves to the global file — skipped: …`.

### Test Coverage

- `test/cli/transcript_answer_once_test.dart` (new): 4 cases driving a real `TranscriptMarkdown` through the gh-1573 commit sequence (fence closed in a grown tail, rollback, mid-tail service traffic); each asserts the answer body and every table row appear **exactly once** — all 4 verified RED on the pre-fix code, GREEN after.
- `test/config/config_service_test.dart`: `cwd == home` case — RED pre-fix (user-only keys warned as dead config), GREEN after.
- Targeted suites re-run green after the fix: `ansi_markdown_test`, `transcript_answer_once_test`, `tui_chrome_test`, `transcript_table_render_test`, `fa_tui_boot_output_coalesce_test`, `fa_tui_test`, `transcript_markdown_perf_test`, `resume_perf_503_test`, all of `test/config/` (493 tests total across these).
- Full `dart test` suite: see final result below (job `sh-123-hn65f29u1o1o5uiei`).

### Notes

- No public API changes; `_WalkResult` gained the seed fields (private class).
- `fa config path` still lists the coincident file under both labels by design — the check pass no longer double-validates it.

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1586
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1586
- **Title**: gh-1573 [BUG] TUI: final assistant answer rendered 3-4 times after a background bash job / btw notices
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1573` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 4
- **Additions**: +373
- **Deletions**: -9
- **Created**: 2026-10-13T10:39:39Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-13T20:18:01Z

## PR Description

Closes #1573
### Root Cause

- `TranscriptMarkdown._rebuild()` re-parsed an appended tail **without the open-block state latched at the commit boundary** (`lib/src/cli/ansi_markdown.dart`). A fence/table whose opener was already committed left its closing line context-less in the tail, so it fell through the in-fence early-out and was emitted again as plain top-level markdown. Each subsequent status `sendOutput` (background-job notices, `/work · Ntok` lines) repeated the commit and grew the duplicate tail — 3–4 copies of the final answer.
- Secondary (low-priority item in the ticket): `fa config check` with `cwd=~` resolved the project scope to `~/.fah/config.yaml` itself and ran the project pass over the same bytes twice, warning every user-only key (`provider`, `model`, `baseUrl`, …) as "dead config".

### Fix

- `lib/src/cli/ansi_markdown.dart`: latch `_pendingFence` / table style / pending-table state at every `_commitTo()` boundary; seed `_walk()` from it and carry per-step block state; grown-tail rollback now rebuilds from the boundary **with the latched seed**, so the closing line is consumed as a block close instead of re-emitted; `_viewRows` is `boundaryRows + tailRows` — never appended onto stale rows.
- `lib/src/config/config_service.dart`: when `projectConfigPath == globalConfigPath`, `check()` skips the project pass with the note `project config resolves to the global file — skipped: …`.

### Test Coverage

- `test/cli/transcript_answer_once_test.dart` (new): 4 cases driving a real `TranscriptMarkdown` through the gh-1573 commit sequence (fence closed in a grown tail, rollback, mid-tail service traffic); each asserts the answer body and every table row appear **exactly once** — all 4 verified RED on the pre-fix code, GREEN after.
- `test/config/config_service_test.dart`: `cwd == home` case — RED pre-fix (user-only keys warned as dead config), GREEN after.
- Targeted suites re-run green after the fix: `ansi_markdown_test`, `transcript_answer_once_test`, `tui_chrome_test`, `transcript_table_render_test`, `fa_tui_boot_output_coalesce_test`, `fa_tui_test`, `transcript_markdown_perf_test`, `resume_perf_503_test`, all of `test/config/` (493 tests total across these).
- Full `dart test` suite: see final result below (job `sh-123-hn65f29u1o1o5uiei`).

### Notes

- No public API changes; `_WalkResult` gained the seed fields (private class).
- `fa config path` still lists the coincident file under both labels by design — the check pass no longer double-validates it.

# pr-1586: gh-1573 [BUG] TUI: final assistant answer rendered 3-4 times after a background bash job / btw notices

## Description

Closes #1573
### Root Cause

- `TranscriptMarkdown._rebuild()` re-parsed an appended tail **without the open-block state latched at the commit boundary** (`lib/src/cli/ansi_markdown.dart`). A fence/table whose opener was already committed left its closing line context-less in the tail, so it fell through the in-fence early-out and was emitted again as plain top-level markdown. Each subsequent status `sendOutput` (background-job notices, `/work · Ntok` lines) repeated the commit and grew the duplicate tail — 3–4 copies of the final answer.
- Secondary (low-priority item in the ticket): `fa config check` with `cwd=~` resolved the project scope to `~/.fah/config.yaml` itself and ran the project pass over the same bytes twice, warning every user-only key (`provider`, `model`, `baseUrl`, …) as "dead config".

### Fix

- `lib/src/cli/ansi_markdown.dart`: latch `_pendingFence` / table style / pending-table state at every `_commitTo()` boundary; seed `_walk()` from it and carry per-step block state; grown-tail rollback now rebuilds from the boundary **with the latched seed**, so the closing line is consumed as a block close instead of re-emitted; `_viewRows` is `boundaryRows + tailRows` — never appended onto stale rows.
- `lib/src/config/config_service.dart`: when `projectConfigPath == globalConfigPath`, `check()` skips the project pass with the note `project config resolves to the global file — skipped: …`.

### Test Coverage

- `test/cli/transcript_answer_once_test.dart` (new): 4 cases driving a real `TranscriptMarkdown` through the gh-1573 commit sequence (fence closed in a grown tail, rollback, mid-tail service traffic); each asserts the answer body and every table row appear **exactly once** — all 4 verified RED on the pre-fix code, GREEN after.
- `test/config/config_service_test.dart`: `cwd == home` case — RED pre-fix (user-only keys warned as dead config), GREEN after.
- Targeted suites re-run green after the fix: `ansi_markdown_test`, `transcript_answer_once_test`, `tui_chrome_test`, `transcript_table_render_test`, `fa_tui_boot_output_coalesce_test`, `fa_tui_test`, `transcript_markdown_perf_test`, `resume_perf_503_test`, all of `test/config/` (493 tests total across these).
- Full `dart test` suite: see final result below (job `sh-123-hn65f29u1o1o5uiei`).

### Notes

- No public API changes; `_WalkResult` gained the seed fields (private class).
- `fa config path` still lists the coincident file under both labels by design — the check pass no longer double-validates it.

# pr-1586: gh-1573 [BUG] TUI: final assistant answer rendered 3-4 times after a background bash job / btw notices

## Description

Closes #1573
### Root Cause

- `TranscriptMarkdown._rebuild()` re-parsed an appended tail **without the open-block state latched at the commit boundary** (`lib/src/cli/ansi_markdown.dart`). A fence/table whose opener was already committed left its closing line context-less in the tail, so it fell through the in-fence early-out and was emitted again as plain top-level markdown. Each subsequent status `sendOutput` (background-job notices, `/work · Ntok` lines) repeated the commit and grew the duplicate tail — 3–4 copies of the final answer.
- Secondary (low-priority item in the ticket): `fa config check` with `cwd=~` resolved the project scope to `~/.fah/config.yaml` itself and ran the project pass over the same bytes twice, warning every user-only key (`provider`, `model`, `baseUrl`, …) as "dead config".

### Fix

- `lib/src/cli/ansi_markdown.dart`: latch `_pendingFence` / table style / pending-table state at every `_commitTo()` boundary; seed `_walk()` from it and carry per-step block state; grown-tail rollback now rebuilds from the boundary **with the latched seed**, so the closing line is consumed as a block close instead of re-emitted; `_viewRows` is `boundaryRows + tailRows` — never appended onto stale rows.
- `lib/src/config/config_service.dart`: when `projectConfigPath == globalConfigPath`, `check()` skips the project pass with the note `project config resolves to the global file — skipped: …`.

### Test Coverage

- `test/cli/transcript_answer_once_test.dart` (new): 4 cases driving a real `TranscriptMarkdown` through the gh-1573 commit sequence (fence closed in a grown tail, rollback, mid-tail service traffic); each asserts the answer body and every table row appear **exactly once** — all 4 verified RED on the pre-fix code, GREEN after.
- `test/config/config_service_test.dart`: `cwd == home` case — RED pre-fix (user-only keys warned as dead config), GREEN after.
- Targeted suites re-run green after the fix: `ansi_markdown_test`, `transcript_answer_once_test`, `tui_chrome_test`, `transcript_table_render_test`, `fa_tui_boot_output_coalesce_test`, `fa_tui_test`, `transcript_markdown_perf_test`, `resume_perf_503_test`, all of `test/config/` (493 tests total across these).
- Full `dart test` suite: see final result below (job `sh-123-hn65f29u1o1o5uiei`).

### Notes

- No public API changes; `_WalkResult` gained the seed fields (private class).
- `fa config path` still lists the coincident file under both labels by design — the check pass no longer double-validates it.

if (globalPath != null &&

# pr-1586: gh-1573 [BUG] TUI: final assistant answer rendered 3-4 times after a background bash job / btw notices

## Description

Closes #1573
### Root Cause

- `TranscriptMarkdown._rebuild()` re-parsed an appended tail **without the open-block state latched at the commit boundary** (`lib/src/cli/ansi_markdown.dart`). A fence/table whose opener was already committed left its closing line context-less in the tail, so it fell through the in-fence early-out and was emitted again as plain top-level markdown. Each subsequent status `sendOutput` (background-job notices, `/work · Ntok` lines) repeated the commit and grew the duplicate tail — 3–4 copies of the final answer.
- Secondary (low-priority item in the ticket): `fa config check` with `cwd=~` resolved the project scope to `~/.fah/config.yaml` itself and ran the project pass over the same bytes twice, warning every user-only key (`provider`, `model`, `baseUrl`, …) as "dead config".

### Fix

- `lib/src/cli/ansi_markdown.dart`: latch `_pendingFence` / table style / pending-table state at every `_commitTo()` boundary; seed `_walk()` from it and carry per-step block state; grown-tail rollback now rebuilds from the boundary **with the latched seed**, so the closing line is consumed as a block close instead of re-emitted; `_viewRows` is `boundaryRows + tailRows` — never appended onto stale rows.
- `lib/src/config/config_service.dart`: when `projectConfigPath == globalConfigPath`, `check()` skips the project pass with the note `project config resolves to the global file — skipped: …`.

### Test Coverage

- `test/cli/transcript_answer_once_test.dart` (new): 4 cases driving a real `TranscriptMarkdown` through the gh-1573 commit sequence (fence closed in a grown tail, rollback, mid-tail service traffic); each asserts the answer body and every table row appear **exactly once** — all 4 verified RED on the pre-fix code, GREEN after.
- `test/config/config_service_test.dart`: `cwd == home` case — RED pre-fix (user-only keys warned as dead config), GREEN after.
- Targeted suites re-run green after the fix: `ansi_markdown_test`, `transcript_answer_once_test`, `tui_chrome_test`, `transcript_table_render_test`, `fa_tui_boot_output_coalesce_test`, `fa_tui_test`, `transcript_markdown_perf_test`, `resume_perf_503_test`, all of `test/config/` (493 tests total across these).
- Full `dart test` suite: see final result below (job `sh-123-hn65f29u1o1o5uiei`).

### Notes

- No public API changes; `_WalkResult` gained the seed fields (private class).
- `fa config path` still lists the coincident file under both labels by design — the check pass no longer double-validates it.

blocks.text:
# pr-1586: gh-1573 [BUG] TUI: final assistant answer rendered 3-4 times after a background bash job / btw notices

## Description

Closes #1573
### Root Cause

- `TranscriptMarkdown._rebuild()` re-parsed an appended tail **without the open-block state latched at the commit boundary** (`lib/src/cli/ansi_markdown.dart`). A fence/table whose opener was already committed left its closing line context-less in the tail, so it fell through the in-fence early-out and was emitted again as plain top-level markdown. Each subsequent status `sendOutput` (background-job notices, `/work · Ntok` lines) repeated the commit and grew the duplicate tail — 3–4 copies of the final answer.
- Secondary (low-priority item in the ticket): `fa config check` with `cwd=~` resolved the project scope to `~/.fah/config.yaml` itself and ran the project pass over the same bytes twice, warning every user-only key (`provider`, `model`, `baseUrl`, …) as "dead config".

### Fix

- `lib/src/cli/ansi_markdown.dart`: latch `_pendingFence` / table style / pending-table state at every `_commitTo()` boundary; seed `_walk()` from it and carry per-step block state; grown-tail rollback now rebuilds from the boundary **with the latched seed**, so the closing line is consumed as a block close instead of re-emitted; `_viewRows` is `boundaryRows + tailRows` — never appended onto stale rows.
- `lib/src/config/config_service.dart`: when `projectConfigPath == globalConfigPath`, `check()` skips the project pass with the note `project config resolves to the global file — skipped: …`.

### Test Coverage

- `test/cli/transcript_answer_once_test.dart` (new): 4 cases driving a real `TranscriptMarkdown` through the gh-1573 commit sequence (fence closed in a grown tail, rollback, mid-tail service traffic); each asserts the answer body and every table row appear **exactly once** — all 4 verified RED on the pre-fix code, GREEN after.
- `test/config/config_service_test.dart`: `cwd == home` case — RED pre-fix (user-only keys warned as dead config), GREEN after.
- Targeted suites re-run green after the fix: `ansi_markdown_test`, `transcript_answer_once_test`, `tui_chrome_test`, `transcript_table_render_test`, `fa_tui_boot_output_coalesce_test`, `fa_tui_test`, `transcript_markdown_perf_test`, `resume_perf_503_test`, all of `test/config/` (493 tests total across these).
- Full `dart test` suite: see final result below (job `sh-123-hn65f29u1o1o5uiei`).

### Notes

- No public API changes; `_WalkResult` gained the seed fields (private class).
- `fa config path` still lists the coincident file under both labels by design — the check pass no longer double-validates it.

### Root Cause

- `TranscriptMarkdown._rebuild()` re-parsed an appended tail **without the open-block state latched at the commit boundary** (`lib/src/cli/ansi_markdown.dart`). A fence/table whose opener was already committed left its closing line context-less in the tail, so it fell through the in-fence early-out and was emitted again as plain top-level markdown. Each subsequent status `sendOutput` (background-job notices, `/work · Ntok` lines) repeated the commit and grew the duplicate tail — 3–4 copies of the final answer.
- Secondary (low-priority item in the ticket): `fa config check` with `cwd=~` resolved the project scope to `~/.fah/config.yaml` itself and ran the project pass over the same bytes twice, warning every user-only key (`provider`, `model`, `baseUrl`, …) as "dead config".

### Fix

- `lib/src/cli/ansi_markdown.dart`: latch `_pendingFence` / table style / pending-table state at every `_commitTo()` boundary; seed `_walk()` from it and carry per-step block state; grown-tail rollback now rebuilds from the boundary **with the latched seed**, so the closing line is consumed as a block close instead of re-emitted; `_viewRows` is `boundaryRows + tailRows` — never appended onto stale rows.
- `lib/src/config/config_service.dart`: when `projectConfigPath == globalConfigPath`, `check()` skips the project pass with the note `project config resolves to the global file — skipped: …`.

### Test Coverage

- `test/cli/transcript_answer_once_test.dart` (new): 4 cases driving a real `TranscriptMarkdown` through the gh-1573 commit sequence (fence closed in a grown tail, rollback, mid-tail service traffic); each asserts the answer body and every table row appear **exactly once** — all 4 verified RED on the pre-fix code, GREEN after.
- `test/config/config_service_test.dart`: `cwd == home` case — RED pre-fix (user-only keys warned as dead config), GREEN after.
- Targeted suites re-run green after the fix: `ansi_markdown_test`, `transcript_answer_once_test`, `tui_chrome_test`, `transcript_table_render_test`, `fa_tui_boot_output_coalesce_test`, `fa_tui_test`, `transcript_markdown_perf_test`, `resume_perf_503_test`, all of `test/config/` (493 tests total across these).
- Full `dart test` suite: see final result below (job `sh-123-hn65f29u1o1o5uiei`).

### Notes

- No public API changes; `_WalkResult` gained the seed fields (private class).
- `fa config path` still lists the coincident file under both labels by design — the check pass no longer double-validates it.

Now I understand the full flow:

- `sync(src)`: `if (!_resumable(src) && !_rollbackGrownTail(src)) { _rebuild(src); ... }`.
- `_rebuild` clears `_pendingSeedTable` at its start ("a refused rollback's seed never survives").

Scenario for the optional pin test ("resize/refused rollback after a rollback armed `_pendingSeedTable` but before it was consumed"):
1. Stream a table + growing tail so that a rollback arms `_pendingSeedTable` (the boundary closed a pending table and the tail grows). Actually `_rollbackGrownTail` arms `_pendingSeedTable = seed` then returns true; then sync proceeds to `_walk(src, from: _through)` which consumes the seed. The seed is consumed in the SAME sync call. For the seed to survive across calls, `_tailThrottled` must return true right after the rollback... Let's check order in `sync`: rollback → `if (src.length == _through) return` → `_tailThrottled` check → walk. If the tail is throttled, the walk doesn't happen and `_pendingSeedTable` survives to the next sync. Then on the next sync, if width changed (resize) → `_resumable` false and `_rollbackGrownTail` false (width != _fmt.width) → `_rebuild` → must clear the stale seed. If `_rebuild` didn't clear it... the next `_walk` after rebuild would consume the stale seed? No — `_rebuild` replaces `_fmt` and `_walk` uses `_fmt.restoreState(table: seed ?? const [])` — with `_fmt` replaced, a stale seed would seed the NEXT incremental walk with wrong rows → duplicated grid. So the guard matters when: rollback armed seed → throttle skips walk → next sync takes the rebuild path (width change or replaced content) → after rebuild, next sync resumable walk must NOT be seeded.

The throttle: `_tailThrottleMinLength` and `_tailThrottleIntervalMs`. Let me check the constants — I saw `_tailThrottleIntervalMs` used. That's timing-dependent — the existing tests avoid depending on wall-clock (or do they?). Alternatively, the seed could survive via a different path...

5b352c016e79ebcd214172749b365f2448bd947f
{
  "key": "pr-1586",
  "fields": {
    "summary": "gh-1573 [BUG] TUI: final assistant answer rendered 3-4 times after a background bash job / btw notices",
    "description": "Closes #1573
### Root Cause

- `TranscriptMarkdown._rebuild()` re-parsed an appended tail **without the open-block state latched at the commit boundary** (`lib/src/cli/ansi_markdown.dart`). A fence/table whose opener was already committed left its closing line context-less in the tail, so it fell through the in-fence early-out and was emitted again as plain top-level markdown. Each subsequent status `sendOutput` (background-job notices, `/work · Ntok` lines) repeated the commit and grew the duplicate tail — 3–4 copies of the final answer.
- Secondary (low-priority item in the ticket): `fa config check` with `cwd=~` resolved the project scope to `~/.fah/config.yaml` itself and ran the project pass over the same bytes twice, warning every user-only key (`provider`, `model`, `baseUrl`, …) as "dead config".

### Fix

- `lib/src/cli/ansi_markdown.dart`: latch `_pendingFence` / table style / pending-table state at every `_commitTo()` boundary; seed `_walk()` from it and carry per-step block state; grown-tail rollback now rebuilds from the boundary **with the latched seed**, so the closing line is consumed as a block close instead of re-emitted; `_viewRows` is `boundaryRows + tailRows` — never appended onto stale rows.
- `lib/src/config/config_service.dart`: when `projectConfigPath == globalConfigPath`, `check()` skips the project pass with the note `project config resolves to the global file — skipped: …`.

### Test Coverage

- `test/cli/transcript_answer_once_test.dart` (new): 4 cases driving a real `TranscriptMarkdown` through the gh-1573 commit sequence (fence closed in a grown tail, rollback, mid-tail service traffic); each asserts the answer body and every table row appear **exactly once** — all 4 verified RED on the pre-fix code, GREEN after.
- `test/config/config_service_test.dart`: `cwd == home` case — RED pre-fix (user-only keys warned as dead config), GREEN after.
- Targeted suites re-run green after the fix: `ansi_markdown_test`, `transcript_answer_once_test`, `tui_chrome_test`, `transcript_table_render_test`, `fa_tui_boot_output_coalesce_test`, `fa_tui_test`, `transcript_markdown_perf_test`, `resume_perf_503_test`, all of `test/config/` (493 tests total across these).
- Full `dart test` suite: see final result below (job `sh-123-hn65f29u1o1o5uiei`).

### Notes

- No public API changes; `_WalkResult` gained the seed fields (private class).
- `fa config path` still lists the coincident file under both labels by design — the check pass no longer double-validates it."
  }
}

with the lexical normalizer

static String _normalizePath(String path) =>

- `lib/src/config/config_service.dart`: when `projectConfigPath == globalConfigPath`, `check()` skips the project pass with the note `project config resolves to the global file — skipped: …`.

- `test/cli/transcript_answer_once_test.dart` (new): 4 cases driving a real `TranscriptMarkdown` through the gh-1573 commit sequence (fence closed in a grown tail, rollback, mid-tail service traffic); each asserts the answer body and every table row appear **exactly once** — all 4 verified RED on the pre-fix code, GREEN after.

- Full `dart test` suite: see final result below (job `sh-123-hn65f29u1o1o5uiei`).

### Notes

- No public API changes; `_WalkResult` gained the seed fields (private class).
- `fa config path` still lists the coincident file under both labels by design — the check pass no longer double-validates it."

    "summary": "gh-1573 [BUG] TUI: final assistant answer rendered 3-4 times after a background bash job / btw notices",
    "description": "Closes #1573
### Root Cause

- `TranscriptMarkdown._rebuild()` re-parsed an appended tail **without the open-block state latched at the commit boundary** (`lib/src/cli/ansi_markdown.dart`). A fence/table whose opener was already committed left its closing line context-less in the tail, so it fell through the in-fence early-out and was emitted again as plain top-level markdown. Each subsequent status `sendOutput` (background-job notices, `/work · Ntok` lines) repeated the commit and grew the duplicate tail — 3–4 copies of the final answer.
- Secondary (low-priority item in the ticket): `fa config check` with `cwd=~` resolved the project scope to `~/.fah/config.yaml` itself and ran the project pass over the same bytes twice, warning every user-only key (`provider`, `model`, `baseUrl`, …) as "dead config".

### Fix

- `lib/src/cli/ansi_markdown.dart`: latch `_pendingFence` / table style / pending-table state at every `_commitTo()` boundary; seed `_walk()` from it and carry per-step block state; grown-tail rollback now rebuilds from the boundary **with the latched seed**, so the closing line is consumed as a block close instead of re-emitted; `_viewRows` is `boundaryRows + tailRows` — never appended onto stale rows.
- `lib/src/config/config_service.dart`: when `projectConfigPath == globalConfigPath`, `check()` skips the project pass with the note `project config resolves to the global file — skipped: …`.

### Test Coverage

- `test/cli/transcript_answer_once_test.dart` (new): 4 cases driving a real `TranscriptMarkdown` through the gh-1573 commit sequence (fence closed in a grown tail, rollback, mid-tail service traffic); each asserts the answer body and every table row appear **exactly once** — all 4 verified RED on the pre-fix code, GREEN after.
- `test/config/config_service_test.dart`: `cwd == home` case — RED pre-fix (user-only keys warned as dead config), GREEN after.
- Targeted suites re-run green after the fix: `ansi_markdown_test`, `transcript_answer_once_test`, `tui_chrome_test`, `transcript_table_render_test`, `fa_tui_boot_output_coalesce_test`, `fa_tui_test`, `transcript_markdown_perf_test`, `resume_perf_503_test`, all of `test/config/` (493 tests total across these).
- Full `dart test` suite: see final result below (job `sh-123-hn65f29u1o1o5uiei`).

### Notes

- No public API changes; `_WalkResult` gained the seed fields (private class).
- `fa config path` still lists the coincident file under both labels by design — the check pass no longer double-validates it."
  }
}

with the lexical normalizer

```dart
static String _normalizePath(String path) =>
    path.replaceAll(RegExp('//+'), '/');
```

A trailing-slash `$HOME`/cwd composes into the file path as a **doubled** slash (`homeDir: '/home/'` → `/home//.fah/config.yaml`), so stripping only a trailing `/` from the final path (as sketched in the thread) would miss the shape; collapsing duplicate slashes handles both spellings — `HOME=/home/` with `cwd=/home`, and the mirrored `cwd=/home/` — before comparing.

{
  "key": "pr-1586",
  "fields": {
    "summary": "gh-1573 [BUG] TUI: final assistant answer rendered 3-4 times after a background bash job / btw notices",
    "description": "Closes #1573
### Root Cause

- `TranscriptMarkdown._rebuild()` re-parsed an appended tail **without the open-block state latched at the commit boundary** (`lib/src/cli/ansi_markdown.dart`). A fence/table whose opener was already committed left its closing line context-less in the tail, so it fell through the in-fence early-out and was emitted again as plain top-level markdown. Each subsequent status `sendOutput` (background-job notices, `/work · Ntok` lines) repeated the commit and grew the duplicate tail — 3–4 copies of the final answer.
- Secondary (low-priority item in the ticket): `fa config check` with `cwd=~` resolved the project scope to `~/.fah/config.yaml` itself and ran the project pass over the same bytes twice, warning every user-only key (`provider`, `model`, `baseUrl`, …) as "dead config".

### Fix

- `lib/src/cli/ansi_markdown.dart`: latch `_pendingFence` / table style / pending-table state at every `_commitTo()` boundary; seed `_walk()` from it and carry per-step block state; grown-tail rollback now rebuilds from the boundary **with the latched seed**, so the closing line is consumed as a block close instead of re-emitted; `_viewRows` is `boundaryRows + tailRows` — never appended onto stale rows.
- `lib/src/config/config_service.dart`: when `projectConfigPath == globalConfigPath`, `check()` skips the project pass with the note `project config resolves to the global file — skipped: …`.

### Test Coverage

- `test/cli/transcript_answer_once_test.dart` (new): 4 cases driving a real `TranscriptMarkdown` through the gh-1573 commit sequence (fence closed in a grown tail, rollback, mid-tail service traffic); each asserts the answer body and every table row appear **exactly once** — all 4 verified RED on the pre-fix code, GREEN after.
- `test/config/config_service_test.dart`: `cwd == home` case — RED pre-fix (user-only keys warned as dead config), GREEN after.
- Targeted suites re-run green after the fix: `ansi_markdown_test`, `transcript_answer_once_test`, `tui_chrome_test`, `transcript_table_render_test`, `fa_tui_boot_output_coalesce_test`, `fa_tui_test`, `transcript_markdown_perf_test`, `resume_perf_503_test`, all of `test/config/` (493 tests total across these).
- Full `dart test` suite: see final result below (job `sh-123-hn65f29u1o1o5uiei`).

### Notes

- No public API changes; `_WalkResult` gained the seed fields (private class).
- `fa config path` still lists the coincident file under both labels by design — the check pass no longer double-validates it."
  }
}

{"content":"💡 Thread addressed — the guard now normalizes both spellings.

**Fix** (`lib/src/config/config_service.dart`, `check()`):

```dart
if (globalPath != null &&
    _normalizePath(projectPath) == _normalizePath(globalPath)) {
```

with the lexical normalizer

```dart
static String _normalizePath(String path) =>
    path.replaceAll(RegExp('//+'), '/');
```

A trailing-slash `$HOME`/cwd composes into the file path as a **doubled** slash (`homeDir: '/home/'` → `/home//.fah/config.yaml`), so stripping only a trailing `/` from the final path (as sketched in the thread) would miss the shape; collapsing duplicate slashes handles both spellings — `HOME=/home/` with `cwd=/home`, and the mirrored `cwd=/home/` — before comparing.

**On symlinks** (`cwd=/private/tmp` vs `HOME=/tmp`): true canonicalization needs `dart:io` (`File.resolveSymbolicLinks`), which this service deliberately lacks — it is pure over the abstract `ExecutionEnv` so the same code backs browser/container hosts through `MemoryExecutionEnv`. That shape stays host-canonicalization territory and is out of scope for this pass; the lexical collapse covers every spelling the composed paths can actually take (`$dir + '/.fah/config.yaml'`).

**Tests** — `test/config/config_service_test.dart`, both verified **RED on the pre-fix code** (user-only keys warned as dead config, exactly the regression the thread predicts) and **GREEN after**:
- `trailing-slash HOME spelling still skips the project pass (gh-1573)`

{
  "key": "pr-1586",
  "fields": {
    "summary": "gh-1573 [BUG] TUI: final assistant answer rendered 3-4 times after a background bash job / btw notices",
    "description": "Closes #1573
### Root Cause

- `TranscriptMarkdown._rebuild()` re-parsed an appended tail **without the open-block state latched at the commit boundary** (`lib/src/cli/ansi_markdown.dart`). A fence/table whose opener was already committed left its closing line context-less in the tail, so it fell through the in-fence early-out and was emitted again as plain top-level markdown. Each subsequent status `sendOutput` (background-job notices, `/work · Ntok` lines) repeated the commit and grew the duplicate tail — 3–4 copies of the final answer.
- Secondary (low-priority item in the ticket): `fa config check` with `cwd=~` resolved the project scope to `~/.fah/config.yaml` itself and ran the project pass over the same bytes twice, warning every user-only key (`provider`, `model`, `baseUrl`, …) as "dead config".

### Fix

- `lib/src/cli/ansi_markdown.dart`: latch `_pendingFence` / table style / pending-table state at every `_commitTo()` boundary; seed `_walk()` from it and carry per-step block state; grown-tail rollback now rebuilds from the boundary **with the latched seed**, so the closing line is consumed as a block close instead of re-emitted; `_viewRows` is `boundaryRows + tailRows` — never appended onto stale rows.
- `lib/src/config/config_service.dart`: when `projectConfigPath == globalConfigPath`, `check()` skips the project pass with the note `project config resolves to the global file — skipped: …`.

### Test Coverage

- `TranscriptMarkdown._rebuild()` re-parsed an appended tail **without the open-block state latched at the commit boundary** (`lib/src/cli/ansi_markdown.dart`). - `lib/src/cli/ansi_markdown.dart`: latch `_pendingFence` / table style / pending-table state at every `_commitTo()` boundary; seed `_walk()` from it and carry per-step block state; grown-tail rollback now rebuilds from the boundary **with the latched seed**, so the closing line is consumed as a block close instead of re-emitted; `_viewRows` is `boundaryRows + tailRows` — never appended onto stale rows.
- `lib/src/config/config_service.dart`: when `projectConfigPath == globalConfigPath`, `check()` skips the project pass with the note `project config resolves to the global file — skipped: …`.

### Notes

  "key": "pr-1586",
  "fields": {
    "summary": "gh-1573 [BUG] TUI: final assistant answer rendered 3-4 times after a background bash job / btw notices",
    "description": "Closes #1573
### Root Cause

- `TranscriptMarkdown._rebuild()` re-parsed an appended tail **without the open-block state latched at the commit boundary** (`lib/src/cli/ansi_markdown.dart`). A fence/table whose opener was already committed left its closing line context-less in the tail, so it fell through the in-fence early-out and was emitted again as plain top-level markdown. Each subsequent status `sendOutput` (background-job notices, `/work · Ntok` lines) repeated the commit and grew the duplicate tail — 3–4 copies of the final answer.
- Secondary (low-priority item in the ticket): `fa config check` with `cwd=~` resolved the project scope to `~/.fah/config.yaml` itself and ran the project pass over the same bytes twice, warning every user-only key (`provider`, `model`, `baseUrl`, …) as "dead config".

### Fix

- `lib/src/cli/ansi_markdown.dart`: latch `_pendingFence` / table style / pending-table state at every `_commitTo()` boundary; seed `_walk()` from it and carry per-step block state; grown-tail rollback now rebuilds from the boundary **with the latched seed**, so the closing line is consumed as a block close instead of re-emitted; `_viewRows` is `boundaryRows + tailRows` — never appended onto stale rows.

    "description": "Closes #1573
### Root Cause

- `TranscriptMarkdown._rebuild()` re-parsed an appended tail **without the open-block state latched at the commit boundary** (`lib/src/cli/ansi_markdown.dart`). A fence/table whose opener was already committed left its closing line context-less in the tail, so it fell through the in-fence early-out and was emitted again as plain top-level markdown. Each subsequent status `sendOutput` (background-job notices, `/work · Ntok` lines) repeated the commit and grew the duplicate tail — 3–4 copies of the final answer.
- Secondary (low-priority item in the ticket): `fa config check` with `cwd=~` resolved the project scope to `~/.fah/config.yaml` itself and ran the project pass over the same bytes twice, warning every user-only key (`provider`, `model`, `baseUrl`, …) as "dead config".

### Fix

- `lib/src/cli/ansi_markdown.dart`: latch `_pendingFence` / table style / pending-table state at every `_commitTo()` boundary; seed `_walk()` from it and carry per-step block state; grown-tail rollback now rebuilds from the boundary **with the latched seed**, so the closing line is consumed as a block close instead of re-emitted; `_viewRows` is `boundaryRows + tailRows` — never appended onto stale rows.
- `lib/src/config/config_service.dart`: when `projectConfigPath == globalConfigPath`, `check()` skips the project pass with the note `project config resolves to the global file — skipped: …`.

### Test Coverage

- `test/cli/transcript_answer_once_test.dart` (new): 4 cases driving a real `TranscriptMarkdown` through the gh-1573 commit sequence (fence closed in a grown tail, rollback, mid-tail service traffic); each asserts the answer body and every table row appear **exactly once** — all 4 verified RED on the pre-fix code, GREEN after.

- Full `dart test` suite: see final result below (job `sh-123-hn65f29u1o1o5uiei`).

### Notes

- No public API changes; `_WalkResult` gained the seed fields (private class).
- `fa config path` still lists the coincident file under both labels by design — the check pass no longer double-validates it."

- CI: green on the rework head — no failures to fix. No merge conflicts.
- 7 open threads at rework start: 4 real review threads (all 💡 SUGGESTION, `threadId`-bearing) + 3 machine notices (`threadId: null` — arming/status boilerplate, not reply targets, per `pr_discussions.md`).
- All 4 suggestion threads are fixed in code this pass; one reply file + one `review_replies.json` entry each.

## Approach

1. **Path-equality guard missed symlinked / trailing-slash spellings** (`lib/src/config/config_service.dart`) — RED→GREEN:

   - The guard now compares normalized spellings: `_normalizePath(path) => path.replaceAll(RegExp('//+'), '/')` on both sides. A trailing-slash `$HOME`/cwd composes into the file path as a **doubled** slash (`/home//.fah/config.yaml`), so collapsing duplicate slashes — not stripping a trailing `/` — is what makes the spellings compare equal.
   - Symlinked spellings (`cwd=/private/tmp` vs `HOME=/tmp`) stay out of scope by design: canonicalization needs `dart:io`, and the service is deliberately pure over the abstract `ExecutionEnv` (same code backs browser/container hosts via `MemoryExecutionEnv`).
2. **`dart format`** (`lib/src/config/config_service.dart`) — formatter run; the flagged `report.notes.add('project config absent (defaults apply): $projectPath')` line collapsed. `--set-exit-if-changed` verifies clean. No unrelated churn.
3. **Redundant first `writeFile`** (`test/config/config_service_test.dart`) — the dead outer-`env` write removed from the `cwd == home` test; test green (77/77 in the file).
4. **Pending-table bookkeeping duplicated between `_walk` and `_rebuild`** (`lib/src/cli/ansi_markdown.dart`) — consolidated into ONE copy:
   - new private `_TableWalkState` holder + `_tableWalkStep(fmt, line, i, state)` consumed by both loops; `_rebuild`'s per-step block is gone entirely.
   - Zero behavior change, pinned by the gh-1573 suites that assert byte-parity with `AnsiMarkdown.formatAll` at every delta step (including the seeded grown-tail rollback and refused-split rebuild paths).

- The review's *optional* follow-up (pin the `_rebuild` seed-clear guard via a resize/refused-rollback-after-arm test) was **not** added: arming `_pendingSeedTable` without consuming it requires the 8KB/100ms tail-throttle window, so the pin would lean on wall-clock timing (flaky CI risk). The seed-clear line itself is now covered indirectly by the parity suites through the consolidated `_tableWalkStep`. Left recorded as the reviewer filed it.

- `lib/src/config/config_service.dart` — `_normalizePath` + normalized guard in `check()`; formatter-clean.
- `test/config/config_service_test.dart` — 2 new trailing-slash RED→GREEN tests; dead `writeFile` removed.
- `lib/src/cli/ansi_markdown.dart` — `_TableWalkState` + `_tableWalkStep` extraction; `_walk`/`_rebuild` now share the per-step bookkeeping.

### Notes

{
  "key": "pr-1586",
  "fields": {
    "summary": "gh-1573 [BUG] TUI: final assistant answer rendered 3-4 times after a background bash job / btw notices",
    "description": "Closes #1573
### Root Cause

- `TranscriptMarkdown._rebuild()` re-parsed an appended tail **without the open-block state latched at the commit boundary** (`lib/src/cli/ansi_markdown.dart`). A fence/table whose opener was already committed left its closing line context-less in the tail, so it fell through the in-fence early-out and was emitted again as plain top-level markdown. Each subsequent status `sendOutput` (background-job notices, `/work · Ntok` lines) repeated the commit and grew the duplicate tail — 3–4 copies of the final answer.
- Secondary (low-priority item in the ticket): `fa config check` with `cwd=~` resolved the project scope to `~/.fah/config.yaml` itself and ran the project pass over the same bytes twice, warning every user-only key (`provider`, `model`, `baseUrl`, …) as "dead config".

### Fix

- `lib/src/cli/ansi_markdown.dart`: latch `_pendingFence` / table style / pending-table state at every `_commitTo()` boundary; seed `_walk()` from it and carry per-step block state; grown-tail rollback now rebuilds from the boundary **with the latched seed**, so the closing line is consumed as a block close instead of re-emitted; `_viewRows` is `boundaryRows + tailRows` — never appended onto stale rows.
- `lib/src/config/config_service.dart`: when `projectConfigPath == globalConfigPath`, `check()` skips the project pass with the note `project config resolves to the global file — skipped: …`.

### Test Coverage

- Full `dart test` suite: see final result below (job `sh-123-hn65f29u1o1o5uiei`).

### Notes

- No public API changes; `_WalkResult` gained the seed fields (private class).
- `fa config path` still lists the coincident file under both labels by design — the check pass no longer double-validates it."

   - The guard now compares normalized spellings: `_normalizePath(path) => path.replaceAll(RegExp('//+'), '/')` on both sides. A trailing-slash `$HOME`/cwd composes into the file path as a **doubled** slash (`/home//.fah/config.yaml`), so collapsing duplicate slashes — not stripping a trailing `/` — is what makes the spellings compare equal.
   - Symlinked spellings (`cwd=/private/tmp` vs `HOME=/tmp`) stay out of scope by design: canonicalization needs `dart:io`, and the service is deliberately pure over the abstract `ExecutionEnv` (same code backs browser/container hosts via `MemoryExecutionEnv`).

    "description": "Closes #1573
### Root Cause

- `TranscriptMarkdown._rebuild()` re-parsed an appended tail **without the open-block state latched at the commit boundary** (`lib/src/cli/ansi_markdown.dart`). A fence/table whose opener was already committed left its closing line context-less in the tail, so it fell through the in-fence early-out and was emitted again as plain top-level markdown. Each subsequent status `sendOutput` (background-job notices, `/work · Ntok` lines) repeated the commit and grew the duplicate tail — 3–4 copies of the final answer.
- Secondary (low-priority item in the ticket): `fa config check` with `cwd=~` resolved the project scope to `~/.fah/config.yaml` itself and ran the project pass over the same bytes twice, warning every user-only key (`provider`, `model`, `baseUrl`, …) as "dead config".

### Fix

- `lib/src/cli/ansi_markdown.dart`: latch `_pendingFence` / table style / pending-table state at every `_commitTo()` boundary; seed `_walk()` from it and carry per-step block state; grown-tail rollback now rebuilds from the boundary **with the latched seed**, so the closing line is consumed as a block close instead of re-emitted; `_viewRows` is `boundaryRows + tailRows` — never appended onto stale rows.
- `lib/src/config/config_service.dart`: when `projectConfigPath == globalConfigPath`, `check()` skips the project pass with the note `project config resolves to the global file — skipped: …`.

### Test Coverage

- `test/cli/transcript_answer_once_test.dart` (new): 4 cases driving a real `TranscriptMarkdown` through the gh-1573 commit sequence (fence closed in a grown tail, rollback, mid-tail service traffic); each asserts the answer body and every table row appear **exactly once** — all 4 verified RED on the pre-fix code, GREEN after.
- `test/config/config_service_test.dart`: `cwd == home` case — RED pre-fix (user-only keys warned as dead config), GREEN after.
- Targeted suites re-run green after the fix: `ansi_markdown_test`, `transcript_answer_once_test`, `tui_chrome_test`, `transcript_table_render_test`, `fa_tui_boot_output_coalesce_test`, `fa_tui_test`, `transcript_markdown_perf_test`, `resume_perf_503_test`, all of `test/config/` (493 tests total across these).
- Full `dart test` suite: see final result below (job `sh-123-hn65f29u1o1o5uiei`).

### Notes

- No public API changes; `_WalkResult` gained the seed fields (private class).
- `fa config path` still lists the coincident file under both labels by design — the check pass no longer double-validates it."

### Root Cause

- `TranscriptMarkdown._rebuild()` re-parsed an appended tail **without the open-block state latched at the commit boundary** (`lib/src/cli/ansi_markdown.dart`). A fence/table whose opener was already committed left its closing line context-less in the tail, so it fell through the in-fence early-out and was emitted again as plain top-level markdown. - Secondary (low-priority item in the ticket): `fa config check` with `cwd=~` resolved the project scope to `~/.fah/config.yaml` itself and ran the project pass over the same bytes twice, warning every user-only key (`provider`, `model`, `baseUrl`, …) as "dead config".

### Fix

- `lib/src/cli/ansi_markdown.dart`: latch `_pendingFence` / table style / pending-table state at every `_commitTo()` boundary; seed `_walk()` from it and carry per-step block state; grown-tail rollback now rebuilds from the boundary **with the latched seed**, so the closing line is consumed as a block close instead of re-emitted; `_viewRows` is `boundaryRows + tailRows` — never appended onto stale rows.
- `lib/src/config/config_service.dart`: when `projectConfigPath == globalConfigPath`, `check()` skips the project pass with the note `project config resolves to the global file — skipped: …`.

### Test Coverage

- `test/cli/transcript_answer_once_test.dart` (new): 4 cases driving a real `TranscriptMarkdown` through the gh-1573 commit sequence (fence closed in a grown tail, rollback, mid-tail service traffic); each asserts the answer body and every table row appear **exactly once** — all 4 verified RED on the pre-fix code, GREEN after.
- `test/config/config_service_test.dart`: `cwd == home` case — RED pre-fix (user-only keys warned as dead config), GREEN after.
- Targeted suites re-run green after the fix: `ansi_markdown_test`, `transcript_answer_once_test`, `tui_chrome_test`, `transcript_table_render_test`, `fa_tui_boot_output_coalesce_test`, `fa_tui_test`, `transcript_markdown_perf_test`, `resume_perf_503_test`, all of `test/config/` (493 tests total across these).
- Full `dart test` suite: see final result below (job `sh-123-hn65f29u1o1o5uiei`).

### Notes

- No public API changes; `_WalkResult` gained the seed fields (private class).
- `fa config path` still lists the coincident file under both labels by design — the check pass no longer double-validates it."
  }
}

static String _normalizePath(String path) =>

   - The guard now compares normalized spellings: `_normalizePath(path) => path.replaceAll(RegExp('//+'), '/')` on both sides. A trailing-slash `$HOME`/cwd composes into the file path as a **doubled** slash (`/home//.fah/config.yaml`), so collapsing duplicate slashes — not stripping a trailing `/` — is what makes the spellings compare equal.
   - Symlinked spellings (`cwd=/private/tmp` vs `HOME=/tmp`) stay out of scope by design: canonicalization needs `dart:io`, and the service is deliberately pure over the abstract `ExecutionEnv` (same code backs browser/container hosts via `MemoryExecutionEnv`).

    "description": "Closes #1573
### Root Cause

- `TranscriptMarkdown._rebuild()` re-parsed an appended tail **without the open-block state latched at the commit boundary** (`lib/src/cli/ansi_markdown.dart`). A fence/table whose opener was already committed left its closing line context-less in the tail, so it fell through the in-fence early-out and was emitted again as plain top-level markdown. Each subsequent status `sendOutput` (background-job notices, `/work · Ntok` lines) repeated the commit and grew the duplicate tail — 3–4 copies of the final answer.
- Secondary (low-priority item in the ticket): `fa config check` with `cwd=~` resolved the project scope to `~/.fah/config.yaml` itself and ran the project pass over the same bytes twice, warning every user-only key (`provider`, `model`, `baseUrl`, …) as "dead config".

### Fix

- `lib/src/cli/ansi_markdown.dart`: latch `_pendingFence` / table style / pending-table state at every `_commitTo()` boundary; seed `_walk()` from it and carry per-step block state; grown-tail rollback now rebuilds from the boundary **with the latched seed**, so the closing line is consumed as a block close instead of re-emitted; `_viewRows` is `boundaryRows + tailRows` — never appended onto stale rows.
- `lib/src/config/config_service.dart`: when `projectConfigPath == globalConfigPath`, `check()` skips the project pass with the note `project config resolves to the global file — skipped: …`.

### Test Coverage

- `test/cli/transcript_answer_once_test.dart` (new): 4 cases driving a real `TranscriptMarkdown` through the gh-1573 commit sequence (fence closed in a grown tail, rollback, mid-tail service traffic); each asserts the answer body and every table row appear **exactly once** — all 4 verified RED on the pre-fix code, GREEN after.

- Full `dart test` suite: see final result below (job `sh-123-hn65f29u1o1o5uiei`).

### Notes

- No public API changes; `_WalkResult` gained the seed fields (private class).
- `fa config path` still lists the coincident file under both labels by design — the check pass no longer double-validates it."

- Full `dart test` suite: see final result below (job `sh-123-hn65f29u1o1o5uiei`).

### Notes

- No public API changes; `_WalkResult` gained the seed fields (private class).
- `fa config path` still lists the coincident file under both labels by design — the check pass no longer double-validates it."

    "summary": "gh-1573 [BUG] TUI: final assistant answer rendered 3-4 times after a background bash job / btw notices",
    "description": "Closes #1573
### Root Cause

- `TranscriptMarkdown._rebuild()` re-parsed an appended tail **without the open-block state latched at the commit boundary** (`lib/src/cli/ansi_markdown.dart`). A fence/table whose opener was already committed left its closing line context-less in the tail, so it fell through the in-fence early-out and was emitted again as plain top-level markdown. Each subsequent status `sendOutput` (background-job notices, `/work · Ntok` lines) repeated the commit and grew the duplicate tail — 3–4 copies of the final answer.
- Secondary (low-priority item in the ticket): `fa config check` with `cwd=~` resolved the project scope to `~/.fah/config.yaml` itself and ran the project pass over the same bytes twice, warning every user-only key (`provider`, `model`, `baseUrl`, …) as "dead config".

### Fix

- `lib/src/cli/ansi_markdown.dart`: latch `_pendingFence` / table style / pending-table state at every `_commitTo()` boundary; seed `_walk()` from it and carry per-step block state; grown-tail rollback now rebuilds from the boundary **with the latched seed**, so the closing line is consumed as a block close instead of re-emitted; `_viewRows` is `boundaryRows + tailRows` — never appended onto stale rows.
- `lib/src/config/config_service.dart`: when `projectConfigPath == globalConfigPath`, `check()` skips the project pass with the note `project config resolves to the global file — skipped: …`.

### Test Coverage

- `test/cli/transcript_answer_once_test.dart` (new): 4 cases driving a real `TranscriptMarkdown` through the gh-1573 commit sequence (fence closed in a grown tail, rollback, mid-tail service traffic); each asserts the answer body and every table row appear **exactly once** — all 4 verified RED on the pre-fix code, GREEN after.
- `test/config/config_service_test.dart`: `cwd == home` case — RED pre-fix (user-only keys warned as dead config), GREEN after.
- Targeted suites re-run green after the fix: `ansi_markdown_test`, `transcript_answer_once_test`, `tui_chrome_test`, `transcript_table_render_test`, `fa_tui_boot_output_coalesce_test`, `fa_tui_test`, `transcript_markdown_perf_test`, `resume_perf_503_test`, all of `test/config/` (493 tests total across these).
- Full `dart test` suite: see final result below (job `sh-123-hn65f29u1o1o5uiei`).

### Notes

- No public API changes; `_WalkResult` gained the seed fields (private class).
- `fa config path` still lists the coincident file under both labels by design — the check pass no longer double-validates it."
  }
}

   - The guard now compares normalized spellings: `_normalizePath(path) => path.replaceAll(RegExp('//+'), '/')` on both sides. A trailing-slash `$HOME`/cwd composes into the file path as a **doubled** slash (`/home//.fah/config.yaml`), so collapsing duplicate slashes — not stripping a trailing `/` — is what makes the spellings compare equal.

    "summary": "gh-1573 [BUG] TUI: final assistant answer rendered 3-4 times after a background bash job / btw notices",
    "description": "Closes #1573
### Root Cause

- `TranscriptMarkdown._rebuild()` re-parsed an appended tail **without the open-block state latched at the commit boundary** (`lib/src/cli/ansi_markdown.dart`). A fence/table whose opener was already committed left its closing line context-less in the tail, so it fell through the in-fence early-out and was emitted again as plain top-level markdown. Each subsequent status `sendOutput` (background-job notices, `/work · Ntok` lines) repeated the commit and grew the duplicate tail — 3–4 copies of the final answer.
- Secondary (low-priority item in the ticket): `fa config check` with `cwd=~` resolved the project scope to `~/.fah/config.yaml` itself and ran the project pass over the same bytes twice, warning every user-only key (`provider`, `model`, `baseUrl`, …) as "dead config".

### Fix

- `lib/src/cli/ansi_markdown.dart`: latch `_pendingFence` / table style / pending-table state at every `_commitTo()` boundary; seed `_walk()` from it and carry per-step block state; grown-tail rollback now rebuilds from the boundary **with the latched seed**, so the closing line is consumed as a block close instead of re-emitted; `_viewRows` is `boundaryRows + tailRows` — never appended onto stale rows.
- `lib/src/config/config_service.dart`: when `projectConfigPath == globalConfigPath`, `check()` skips the project pass with the note `project config resolves to the global file — skipped: …`.

### Test Coverage

1. **Path-equality guard missed symlinked / trailing-slash spellings** (`lib/src/config/config_service.dart`) — RED→GREEN:

   - The guard now compares normalized spellings: `_normalizePath(path) => path.replaceAll(RegExp('//+'), '/')` on both sides. A trailing-slash `$HOME`/cwd composes into the file path as a **doubled** slash (`/home//.fah/config.yaml`), so collapsing duplicate slashes — not stripping a trailing `/` — is what makes the spellings compare equal.
   - Symlinked spellings (`cwd=/private/tmp` vs `HOME=/tmp`) stay out of scope by design: canonicalization needs `dart:io`, and the service is deliberately pure over the abstract `ExecutionEnv` (same code backs browser/container hosts via `MemoryExecutionEnv`).

   - RED first: 2 new tests in `test/config/config_service_test.dart` (`trailing-slash HOME`, `trailing-slash cwd`) — both failed on the pre-fix code with exactly the predicted false "dead config" warnings for `provider`/`model`/`baseUrl`/`mode`/`approvalMode`.
   - The guard now compares normalized spellings: `_normalizePath(path) => path.replaceAll(RegExp('//+'), '/')` on both sides. A trailing-slash `$HOME`/cwd composes into the file path as a **doubled** slash (`/home//.fah/config.yaml`), so collapsing duplicate slashes — not stripping a trailing `/` — is what makes the spellings compare equal.
   - Symlinked spellings (`cwd=/private/tmp` vs `HOME=/tmp`) stay out of scope by design: canonicalization needs `dart:io`, and the service is deliberately pure over the abstract `ExecutionEnv` (same code backs browser/container hosts via `MemoryExecutionEnv`).
